programme.title: 花甲少年趣旅行 吃喝玩樂全攻略
programme.desc: 這是一段花甲老熟肉與少年小鮮肉們，跨越大齡差距，結伴而行的明星青春旅行到底小鮮肉們想什麼？而老熟肉們又會怎麼玩？透過世代差異，激盪出觀眾意想不到的旅行火花！全台唯一全明星跨世代旅遊實境節目，紀錄跨世代的藝人們難忘的友情之旅！

programme.title: 全民星攻略
programme.desc: 由館長曾國城擔任知識把關者，考驗著每個來挑戰九宮格益智遊戲的藝人明星想要攻略九宮格關卡，透過創意聯想邏輯推理理性分析，才有機會獲取智慧星幣，帶走夢幻大獎

programme.title: 效廉出發吧！今天去哪玩
programme.desc: 全新型態與組合的旅遊綜藝實境節目:逗趣大叔-許效舜熱血青年-廖威廉兩人逍遙環島瘋玩台灣這是一段見證男人友誼的旅行,帶著簡單行囊 騎上熱血摩托車欣賞每個城鎮獨有的歷史人文,探索體驗每個地方的特色美食與生活,分享彼此人生故事,更彌足珍貴的是知己談心為彼此充電,有別其他旅遊美食節目的樂趣和放鬆

programme.title: 桃花映江山
programme.desc: 北苑國公主姜桃花（孟子義 飾）千里迢迢來到大祈和親，卻慘遭設局陷害清白盡毀為了在危機四伏的異國苟活，桃花將錯就錯，嫁給了權傾朝野習慣獨行的冷酷左相沈在野（劉學義 飾），憑著一流的逢場作戲本領與極強的求生欲，展開驚心動魄的生存戰

programme.title: 我金子般的明星
programme.desc: 1990年代，奉清慈（嚴正化 飾）是韓國娛樂圈呼風喚雨的巨星，卻在事業巔峰之際遭遇意外，陷入長達25年的昏迷當她奇蹟般甦醒時，發現這世界早已天翻地覆，青春美貌不再，取而代之的是50歲的大媽外表...

programme.title: 我金子般的明星
programme.desc: 1990年代，奉清慈（嚴正化 飾）是韓國娛樂圈呼風喚雨的巨星，卻在事業巔峰之際遭遇意外，陷入長達25年的昏迷當她奇蹟般甦醒時，發現這世界早已天翻地覆，青春美貌不再，取而代之的是50歲的大媽外表...

programme.title: 57健康同學會
programme.desc: 不管你是注重養生的四五年級，還是邁入熟男熟女的六年級生，或是充滿活力的七年級生，主播張雅琴和醫藥記者及健康專家，要告訴大家自己的身體密碼，讓你健康滿分！

programme.title: 歐若拉公主
programme.desc: 是一部講述大企業天王食品會長家的獨生女吳若拉對完美挑剔男的小說家黃馬馬一見鍾情，描述吳若拉家族和黃馬馬家族之間所發生的事情的電視劇

programme.title: 世上最漂亮的女兒
programme.desc: 經營雪濃湯店的單親媽媽朴善子（金海淑 飾），含辛茹苦將三個女兒撫養長大大女兒姜美善（裕善 飾）是標準的職業婦女，在蠟燭兩頭燒的職場與家庭間疲於奔命，不僅要應付強勢挑剔的婆婆，還得將年幼的女兒託付給娘家媽媽照顧二女兒姜美莉（金素妍 飾）是擁有高學歷與高薪的大企業行銷部長，為了不讓母親操心，美莉拚命工作，但在遇上新進職員韓泰柱（洪宗玄 飾）後，不僅感情迎來轉變，隱藏在身世背後與親生母親的複雜糾葛也逐漸浮上檯面小女兒姜美慧（金荷景 飾）曾是拿過文學獎的天才小說家，如今卻陷入漫長的創作低潮，只能暫時在媽媽的湯店裡幫忙打雜，尋找人生的下一個方向母女間時而爭吵時而相依為命的深厚羈絆，最堅強的後盾，就是媽媽?

programme.title: 我的女兒孝心
programme.desc: 將一生奉獻給家人的李孝心，本是田徑的明日之星，因代替拋家棄子的父親扛下養家重擔只好輟學孝心要照顧媽媽兩個哥哥和一個弟弟，她在江南的健身中心工作，每天一大早就開始為家人的生活奔走，不僅要做體力活，還得應付各種情緒，長期下來令她疲憊不堪這天，孝心決定自立門戶追求屬於自己的幸福生活，而家人們也該各自學習獨立了?

programme.desc: 北苑國公主姜桃花（孟子義 飾）千里迢迢來到大祈和親，卻慘遭設局陷害清白盡毀為了在危機四伏的異國苟活，桃花將錯就錯，嫁給了權傾朝野習慣獨行的冷酷左相沈在野（劉學義 飾），憑著一流的逢場作戲本領與極強的求生欲，展開驚心動魄的生存戰

programme.title: 歐若拉公主
programme.desc: 是一部講述大企業天王食品會長家的獨生女吳若拉對完美挑剔男的小說家黃馬馬一見鍾情，描述吳若拉家族和黃馬馬家族之間所發生的事情的電視劇

programme.title: 世上最漂亮的女兒
programme.desc: 經營雪濃湯店的單親媽媽朴善子（金海淑 飾），含辛茹苦將三個女兒撫養長大大女兒姜美善（裕善 飾）是標準的職業婦女，在蠟燭兩頭燒的職場與家庭間疲於奔命，不僅要應付強勢挑剔的婆婆，還得將年幼的女兒託付給娘家媽媽照顧二女兒姜美莉（金素妍 飾）是擁有高學歷與高薪的大企業行銷部長，為了不讓母親操心，美莉拚命工作，但在遇上新進職員韓泰柱（洪宗玄 飾）後，不僅感情迎來轉變，隱藏在身世背後與親生母親的複雜糾葛也逐漸浮上檯面小女兒姜美慧（金荷景 飾）曾是拿過文學獎的天才小說家，如今卻陷入漫長的創作低潮，只能暫時在媽媽的湯店裡幫忙打雜，尋找人生的下一個方向母女間時而爭吵時而相依為命的深厚羈絆，最堅強的後盾，就是媽媽?

programme.title: 我金子般的明星
programme.desc: 1990年代，奉清慈（嚴正化 飾）是韓國娛樂圈呼風喚雨的巨星，卻在事業巔峰之際遭遇意外，陷入長達25年的昏迷當她奇蹟般甦醒時，發現這世界早已天翻地覆，青春美貌不再，取而代之的是50歲的大媽外表...

programme.desc: 洋片幕後趣

programme.title: 最初的晚餐
programme.desc: 麟太郎（染谷將太 飾）和姐姐美也子（戶田惠梨香 飾）?了父親（永瀨正敏 飾）的葬禮返回家鄉，在守靈夜開始之前，母親秋子卻（齊藤由貴 飾）取消了所有的餐點並親自下廚隨著秋子端出一道道熟悉的料理，全家人回想起20年前，新媽媽秋子帶著大哥哥舜（窪塚洋介 飾）加入後五人一起生活的點滴，無論是曾經一起出遊的快樂回憶或是為了習慣差異出現的種種摩擦，不僅讓麟太郎他們重新思考家人的定義，更想起15年前，哥哥舜在一夜之間離家後再也沒回家的往事

programme.title: 地球過後
programme.desc: 地球毀滅的一千年後，人類被迫離開地球遷往諾瓦星球定居傳奇艦長西佛雷吉威爾史密斯 飾演剛從銀河系完成任務，準備返家照顧久未謀面的13歲兒子奇泰雷吉杰登史密斯 飾演 一場行星風暴卻摧毀了他們的太空船，雷吉父子被迫緊急降落面目全非而充滿危險的地球奇泰因父親西佛重傷臥倒於座艙奄奄一息，必須盡快修復飛船與勇敢跨越未知領域發出求救訊號，同時，他也必須面對已在地球上進化的各種可怕生物以及兇猛的外星怪獸...從小即渴望與父親一樣勇敢的奇泰，如何衝破父子間的隔閡化解致命困境，找到回家的路？

programme.title: 怪胎一族
programme.desc: 講述電視劇情之前的故事以及角色們的起源

programme.title: 絕地戰警FOR LIFE
programme.desc: 來自邁阿密警局的黃金拍檔，在重現許多經典帥氣的動作場面之餘，也不忘維持自己一貫的搞笑風格！ 馬奎斯（馬汀勞倫斯 飾）已經是巡官，麥克威爾史密斯 飾卻步入中年危機，這回他們再次搭檔，為了新任務出馬！暌違17年系列電影重起上路，兩位大叔對上由凡妮莎哈金斯所率領的新世代警探的挑釁，新舊世代究竟會擦出什麼樣的動作火花？

programme.title: 頭文字D
programme.desc: 講述一個十八歲的青年藤原拓海如何從默默無聞的送貨員變成出神入化賽車高手，在迂回曲折的秋明山路間面對一連串驚險的挑戰賽！

programme.title: 蜘蛛人-離家日
programme.desc: 故事接續復仇者聯盟：終局之戰後所發生的事，蜘蛛人彼得帕克在經歷一連串的戰鬥與生離死別後，依然沉浸在悲痛情緒中，他決定暫時卸下自己鄰家英雄的身分，跟好友來趟歐洲之旅，享受高中生活然而神盾局局長尼克福瑞與神秘法師的出現，讓他被迫捲入調查幾宗橫跨城市造成重大死傷的未知怪物攻擊事件，這美好旅行一夕間全變了樣?

programme.title: 一級玩家
programme.desc: 在瀕臨混亂與瓦解邊緣的2045年，人們為了逃避現實而進入虛擬世界綠洲OASIS中綠洲是由鬼才詹姆士哈勒代所創建，他宣布要把5千億的遺產留給第一個找到隱藏在綠洲中程式彩蛋的人，同時也可以掌控綠洲這個消息引發全球玩家的激烈競爭，因控制綠洲就等於控制了世界與未來 一位名不見經傳的少年韋德瓦茲泰謝里丹 飾，以黑馬之姿加入競爭，陷入了一場生死攸關的尋寶遊戲...

programme.title: 是誰搞的鬼
programme.desc: 五個朋友意外造成死亡車禍，決定隱瞞事實發誓保密一年後，當時的所作所為又浮上檯面透過特地前來南港製作與1997年有關的連環殺人案節目的Podcaster黛樂，艾娃等人發現現正發生的事情與當年如出一徹，從丹妮卡收到一封沒有署名上面僅寫有我知道你去年夏天做了什麼的小卡開始，到被穿著雨衣拿著鐵鉤殺人的人追殺，艾娃等人在遭到殺手追殺時，轉向1997年南港大屠殺的倖存者求助...

programme.title: 古曼童
programme.desc: 改編自越南首起連續殺人事件，講述住在湄公河三角洲村莊的聾啞女孩索依，在偶然之下認識了一位自稱是薩滿和治療師的陌生人小耿在小耿奇蹟般地治癒了一個當地人後，他很快便贏得村民的信任與讚賞索依也因而被小耿深深吸引，兩人不久便陷入熱戀並結為連理然而當索依無意間發現小耿過往的黑暗祕密，以及他試圖尋求永生的恐怖計畫後，她的美夢很快地成為了一場噩夢

programme.title: 分秒幣爭
programme.desc: 以1997年亞洲金融風暴期間韓國向國際貨幣基金組織申請援助而展開的談判為背景，敘述了三個獨立的故事

programme.title: 騎機男孩
programme.desc: 薩格林是個25歲的傢伙，他的母親希望他成為銀行行員，但他考了21次都沒考上為了讓家人開心，他每天早上還是穿著銀行制服出門，然後去當摩托車司機但是，當他遇到高中初戀佳茹，而她的男友A哥正是銀行經理，開始懷疑他的身分，企圖想揭穿

programme.title: 戰略陰謀-失控任務
programme.desc: 聯邦特務捲入複雜人口販賣組織機構，中央情報局新秀狙擊手布蘭登貝克特與他的前盟友國土安全局特務席羅和刺客死亡夫人攜手揭開這個特務的貪汙真面目，並摧毀犯罪組織

programme.title: 倒數反擊
programme.desc: 前海軍陸戰隊的湯瑪斯，是一名偷天換日的神鬼大盜，曾連續犯下12家銀行搶案並盜取九百多萬美金，直到他因遇見了安妮後決定金盆洗手，當他向聯邦調查局提出交出所有金錢以換取減刑的交易，卻沒想到遭到警方陷害，遭到天羅地網的追捕的他，必須想辦法反擊，來證明自己的清白

programme.title: 天作之合
programme.desc: 達珂塔強生飾演在紐約打拼，充滿抱負的年輕戀愛顧問露西，想不到戰無不勝的她，在一場婚禮遇到了業界傳說中的獨角獸，眾人幻想中的黃金單身漢，擁有名車和一千兩百萬美金的豪宅，幽默風趣又有品味，簡直完美但是在命運的作弄下，仍在為五斗米折腰的前男友，卻在此時又闖進她的人生，當我看著妳的臉，我看到皺紋和長得很像妳的小孩一直深愛她的前男友，讓露西開始重新思考人生的價值，愛情婚姻物質和現實

programme.title: 緣來大飯店
programme.desc: 講述懷著各自的故事來到埃姆羅斯飯店（Hotel Emross）的人們，以各自的方式製造只屬於自己的緣分的故事

programme.title: 絕地戰警-生死與共
programme.desc: 在伊莎貝爾阿雷塔斯去世四年後，警探麥克勞瑞與他的物理治療師克莉絲汀結婚在婚禮上，他的搭檔，警探馬庫斯伯內特，突然心臟病發並陷入昏迷在昏迷中，他看見康拉德霍華德隊長的幻象，告訴他還不是他的時候...

programme.title: 末日之戰
programme.desc: 因為不明的病毒，造成活屍災情波及全世界，在染病人數不斷暴增的狀況下，感染者很快地癱瘓了軍隊和政府，人類面臨前所未有的末日浩劫前聯合國調查人員傑瑞藍恩，為了保護家人，必須在有限的時間內展開調查，挺身反抗這全球浩劫

programme.title: 自我照護小教室
programme.desc: 自我照護小教室

programme.title: 效廉出發吧！今天去哪玩
programme.desc: 全新型態與組合的旅遊綜藝實境節目:逗趣大叔-許效舜熱血青年-廖威廉兩人逍遙環島瘋玩台灣這是一段見證男人友誼的旅行,帶著簡單行囊 騎上熱血摩托車欣賞每個城鎮獨有的歷史人文,探索體驗每個地方的特色美食與生活,分享彼此人生故事,更彌足珍貴的是知己談心為彼此充電,有別其他旅遊美食節目的樂趣和放鬆

programme.title: 小姐不熙娣
programme.desc: 自帶女王氣勢的 IPSS 的女王小Ｓ，睽違六年強勢回歸！以女性出發點的節目議題，聚焦女性的職場與生活感受

programme.title: 夢想街57號-預約你的夢想
programme.desc: 提供最新最即時的新車資訊邀請汽車達人分享試車報告同時幫觀眾做最仔細的車款集評還有專家分享最實用最省錢的愛車維修撇步，甚至將難得一見的限量車改裝車等直接搬到棚內汽車節目，不再只是純座談的方式，而是將更專業更豐富更多元化的內容呈現給觀眾

programme.title: 我的眼裡只有你
programme.desc: 李盈怡（裴盧麗 飾）在丈夫過世後成為單親媽媽，白天在婆家經營30年的老牌牛骨湯店工作，晚上則到超商兼職，為女兒金美莉娜（尹採? 飾）努力存錢即便孤獨悲傷，盈怡也不輕易哭泣，直到遇見泰盛零售家族長孫張慶俊（白成鉉 飾）後，兩人的愛情羅曼史即將展開?

programme.title: 進擊的台灣
programme.desc: 進擊的台灣努力呈現出台灣社會各行各業小人物的故事，透過這些平凡人對生活工作的態度，讓觀眾見證他們不凡的精采人生期望以此高品質又能激勵人心的節目，與台灣民眾共同守護我們的一片淨土

programme.title: 請問今晚住誰家
programme.desc: 全新一檔真人打工旅遊實境節目，每趟旅程皆由三位身分不同的型男組成的 型男打工團，一起結伴遠離都市塵囂，探訪最療癒的鄉間祕境

programme.title: 全民星攻略

programme.desc: 故事為電視版的前傳，設定於電視版的三年前，片尾結局將連接電視版第一集三年前的吳英雄，血氣方剛，在南區分局重案特勤組執勤，一辦案把整座城市鬧得天下大亂，被組長勒令外勤，卻固執追尋一宗離奇案件而城市的另一邊，最大黑幫三聯會的西岸堂口，年紀最大的三級幹部---徐達夫，挪用堂主的100萬現金偷偷去做鑽石買賣漆黑的貨櫃倉儲區，交易到手的達夫，突然遭受一支重裝隊伍亂槍掃射攻擊，混亂之中，循著線索來到現場的英雄就此碰上徐達夫...

programme.title: 武替道
programme.desc: 動作導演李森曾紅極一時，卻因一次事故轉行，開起跌打醫館舊友拍攝告別作請他重出江湖，不料他卻與昔日冤家特技演員阿威狹路相逢，同時還要面對難解的父女課題

programme.title: 非常殺手
programme.desc: 講述傳奇冷酷殺手義康引退後努力保持低調生活，直至某天卻被要求幫忙照顧任性的女高中生允智，豈料允智遭綁架令義康的殺手本能就此覺醒！

programme.title: 洪興仔之江湖大風暴
programme.desc: 打仔洪興，四仔東星是一句江湖上流傳已久的話洪興的老大洪勝與子洪飛梁朝偉父子不和已多年，因當年洪勝為救幫中兄弟舍棄了妻女的性命，飛對此一直耿耿於懷小春陳小春乃阿B手下，向來開殺時聲音大，膽子卻很小，但他是飛的崇拜者，一次小春在與東星的廝鬥中被東星幫少主阿寶和垃圾追殺，幸好飛經過救下小春小春遇到偶像十分興奮，在一次賽車中把自己的妹妹小彤李若彤介紹給飛認識彤是一家報館的記者，聰明活潑，且對江湖上的事情非常好奇，因此對飛非常感興趣，在交往的過程中逐漸兩人產生了感情在洪勝金盆洗手的當晚，東星幫眾人到場挑釁，要求洪勝交出曾打傷阿寶的小春，正好飛前來澄清了事實，東星的人灰溜溜離去，但飛父子倆為了當年的事情再度衝突，飛憤憤離去...

programme.title: 小姐不熙娣:263
programme.desc: 自帶女王氣勢的IPSS 的女王小S，睽違六年強勢回歸！ 以女性出發點的節目議題，聚焦女性的職場與生活感受

programme.title: 全民星攻略:263
programme.desc: 用智慧掌握機會才能創造獨一無二的命運 全民星攻略智慧星幣翻倍賽 不變的是廣度與深度的知識含量

programme.title: 今晚開讚吧:267
programme.desc: 結合不同族群社團粉絲團民調排行榜合作！ 利用大數據分析，反應市場趨勢，精準抓出熱門關注話題！

programme.title: 至尊無上2之永霸天下
programme.desc: 凡獲賭神金牌, 必可得其相助. 擁有一金牌之范老大因被大徒弟 Tommy 出賣而慘死, 小徒弟希望剛出獄的二師兄杰對付 Tommy, 但遭拒絕. 後 Tommy 為尋賭神金牌而苦苦相迫, 杰終忍無可忍, 決清理門戶.....

programme.title: 正牌韋小寶之奉旨溝女
programme.desc: 該片講述了韋小寶穿越古今，尋找真鳳皇后與康熙匹配而引

programme.title: 上海皇帝之雄霸天下
programme.desc: 由於陸雲生極好面子，因此興辦銀行以接近上海文化界，彌補自己的文盲自卑感，更渴望當官漂白兼光耀門楣，遂暗中幫助國民政府做事以期謀得一官半職，先是協助打擊共產黨，後來又出錢出力幫政府對抗日本的侵略

programme.title: 逃學威龍2
programme.desc: 警務處長因失去佩鎗，懷疑被曾到警署參觀的中學生偷去，遂派飛虎隊員周星星潛入學校，扮學生作臥底，以尋回失鎗自幼對讀書不感興趣的星突然重返校園，其感覺直如坐牢小息時，突萌逃學意念，被扮校工接應他的達叔阻止為完成任務，星只好硬著頭皮呆在學校，幸好美麗動人的社工Miss Ho為星沉悶的學校生涯，帶來色彩幾經困難，星終查得失鎗下落，更誤打誤撞破獲一宗軍火買賣軍火走私客荷鎗實彈到學校找星，擄了一群學生作人質星英勇地救回學生，不但嬴得學生的尊敬，更嬴得Miss Ho的歡心

programme.title: 重案組
programme.desc: 身為探長的洪定邦服務皇家香港警察隊三十多年，才幹超卓，但卻無緣升職眼見臨近退休，決把心一橫，勾結賊人綁架富商王一飛，勒索六千萬警方派陳幫辦負責調查，就在調查過程中，洪定邦的犯案者身份被陳幫辦識破，只好千方百計，阻止陳幫辦搜集證據......

programme.title: 逃學戰警
programme.desc: 吳奇隆金城武楊彩妮聯手演出吳和金是警界的新拍檔，更是香港打擊犯罪的新希望，香港警界突然接獲密令要保護中共高幹之寶貝女兒，此任務交託給吳和金，他們改變身份進入學校，鬧出不少笑話

programme.title: 初次為了愛

programme.title: 長歌行
programme.desc: 原是永寧郡主的李長歌因玄武門之變父喪母亡，她僥倖逃出城，赴幽州求援；途中，偶遇化名秦准的草原部落特勤阿詩勒隼，兩人不打不相識，漸生英雄相惜之感長歌在幽州粉碎一場陰謀，但郡主的身份卻敗露，前往?州避禍長歌藏於?州太守公孫恆身邊，助其共抗草原勢力侵襲，卻未想到敵方將領阿詩勒隼竟是自己的舊識秦准

programme.desc: 小Q自出生便帶著與眾不同的胎記出生，長大後由導盲犬訓練員Simon（羅仲謙 飾）悉心訓練，帶到甜品名廚李寶庭（任達華 飾）家中配對，寶庭因失明導致脾氣暴躁，不只喝斥妹妹（梁詠琪 飾），更三番四次趕走小Q，但受過嚴格導盲訓練的小Q依然不離不棄，任何情況下也以身護主，忠誠終於解開寶庭心結，促使他勇於開闊新生活，不因失明停步，繼續鑽研新甜品！然而隨著小Q年?漸大，寶庭急病，人與狗將面對無可避免的分離......

programme.desc: 朝廷打壓武林，五大派被收編英雄名冊，交由東廠提督仇不群管治，江湖名存實亡，英雄不再！玉雲龍跟姐姐嬌鳳經營平安客棧，一直遠離武林中事但雲龍為奪舊愛艾冰冰芳心，決意逐鹿新晉英雄大賽，卻因揭發東廠黑幕被押入大牢嬌鳳為救雲龍，訛稱平安客棧暗藏異寶，招致各路隱世英雄齊集仇在心奉義父不群之命親近雲龍探查寶物，與雲龍漸生情愫，二人更無意中救出被困多年的武林盟主任我飛！沉睡多時的武林，可會因此翻生？

programme.title: 迷網:23
programme.desc: 科技罪案組高級督察司徒忠督察蕭美婷在工作上亦師亦友，屢破各種電話網絡科技騙案；司徒忠在偵查一宗網上情緣案件的過程中，重遇前度女友張慧，碰巧她與丈夫沈子浩關係破裂，司徒忠與張慧愛火得以重燃與此同時，倫敦金騙案鬧得滿城風雨，而子浩與張慧亦牽連其中，危機四伏......

programme.title: 天天天晴:11
programme.desc: 龍福是本地名門石敢當集團旗下的珠寶店，在老闆娘明心安領導下，經歷九七回歸亞洲金融風暴沙士和金融海嘯等大大小小風波，由瀕臨結業至成為數一數二的珠寶店品牌精明的心深受店內員工及同行敬重，令人艷羨雖然風光背後事業和家庭各有隱憂，但樂觀的她積極面對，充滿正能量

programme.title: 棟仁的時光:17
programme.desc: 一個吻可以改寫甚麼？一個媽媽的吻別，令閏秒出生就夭折的曾棟仁奇蹟地活下來一個急救之吻，救護員程敏琦令棟仁得以續命，讓他知道自己有偷時間續命的能力，也讓敏琦昏睡兩日，錯過了自己的婚禮，未婚夫還離奇失蹤！一個借來的吻，同時感應到對方的想法或感受，令棟仁攀上事業高峰，並足以協助身邊人改寫命運：改善單親爸爸張潮岸的父女關係激發廢青羅瑞楠的鬥志一個最後續命之吻，也是愛人敏琦奪命之吻，棟仁會如何抉擇？

programme.desc: 很多人都說法律只保護懂法律的人，但法律其實不難懂，它甚至和你我的生活息息相關，無論是租屋購物婚姻家庭旅行等都可能扯上法律；一般人遇到了總是慌了手腳，不知如何處理甚至抱持著鴕鳥心態選擇置之不理，最後有可能造成更加難以收拾的局面！節目特別以專業律師團及藝人的精彩案例為主軸，透過他們親身經歷的真實故事，帶出一般民眾常見的法律困擾，讓觀眾在輕鬆的氛圍中了解及面對生活周遭的法律問題懂得保護自己，不再害怕法律

programme.title: Return of the Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: After Ah Niu gets out of jail, he gets involved again with his crooked Uncle Chou and caught in other rackets and silly situations.

programme.title: The Blood Brothers ((The Blood 兄弟))
programme.desc: A pillar of the Qing establishment kills his blood brother to steal the mans wife. Also starring David Chiang. (清政的支柱杀死了他的血兄弟,为了偷窃他的妻子.)

programme.title: Moods of Love ((风花雪月))
programme.desc: How far would you go for love? Or lust? These are the questions posed in two, sinfully entertaining Sung Dynasty tales that comprise this film. (朝的两个故事中提出的这些问题,)

programme.title: The Female Prince ((这个王妃有点萌))
programme.desc: Ivy Ling Po and Chin Han return with a Huangmei Opera classic, depicting a loving couple whose marriage is being poisoned by the husbands stepmother. (爱文波和汉带来了黄美歌剧经典, 描绘着一个热爱的夫妇,)

programme.title: Duel for Gold ((火并))
programme.desc: Famed director Chor Yuen has three pairs of cunning crooks on a quest to steal a million gold taels from the Fu Lai Treasury House but one is undercover. (著名的导演乔有三对的骗子在寻找从福莱财务馆偷走一百万金,)

programme.title: Hong Kong Nocturne ((香江花月夜))
programme.desc: Three sisters the quietest and most filial of whom is played by Cheng Pei Pei attempt to sing and dance their way to happiness. (佩佩饰演的三个姐妹,最安静和最亲属的,)

programme.title: King Gambler ((千王之王重出江湖))
programme.desc: In this lively forerunner to the gambling film craze, two cardsharks spar in a battle of wits and fists to become king of the casino. (在这场博电影狂热的前中,两个卡在智慧和拳头的战斗中成为场的国王.)

programme.title: Lets Fall in Love (让我们爱上)
programme.desc: Pressured by his parents to marry prior to taking over his fathers business, Guan rejects every girl they find but then, he stumbles upon the perfect one? (他被父母压迫嫁给,然后接管父亲的业务,)

programme.title: Magnificent Wanderers (伟大的漫游者)
programme.desc: Share the adventures of patriot Chu Tieh-hsieh and his three comrades, who head out with the aim of relieving Mongolian invaders of their ill-gotten gains. (让我们分享爱国者楚蒂希希和他的三位同志的冒险,)

programme.title: We Love Millionaires ((我爱金龟婿))
programme.desc: 3 beautiful salesgirls masquerade as high society belles in a bid to realize their dreams of marrying millionaires. (三位漂亮的卖家扮演高层士, 为了实现他们嫁给百万富翁的梦想.)

programme.title: The Brave Archer 2 ((射雕英雄传续集))
programme.desc: In this Brave Archer sequel, Kuo Tsings Alexander Fu Sheng love for Huang Yung Niu Niu is challenged by Ouyang Fung. (在这部勇敢的弓箭手续集中,郭清斯亚历山大福盛对黄永纽纽纽的爱情被乌阳丰挑战.)

programme.title: Big Times for the Crazy Bumpkins ((阿牛发达记))
programme.desc: When a bag of jewels falls from the sky, thats just the start of Ah Nius misadventures involving a brothel, a disastrous wedding night and the cops! (当一袋珠宝从天空上落下来,这只是阿尼斯的开始, 涉及一个妓院,)

programme.title: The Crimson Charm ((血符门))
programme.desc: Ivy Ling Po and Chang Yi play a noble swordsman and a one-armed swordswoman who find themselves up against the evil Crimson Charm gang of thieves and thugs. (艾维波和张扮演一位贵族剑手和一名一手剑手女,)

programme.title: The Younger Generation ((年青的一代))
programme.desc: After a young mother and her husband die, one child is sold into prostitution to feed the other four. (一个年轻的母亲和丈夫死后,一个孩子被卖给妓女,)

programme.title: Purple Darts ((紫金镖))
programme.desc: A girl vows to take revenge against the 4 outlaws who murdered her parents when she was only a baby. To do so, she trains hard at martial arts and teams up with a swordsman to kill them. (一个女孩发誓要报复4名杀害她的父母的罪犯,)

programme.title: To Kill a Jaguar ((绝不低头))
programme.desc: In this twist-filled action film, a country girl is saved by a hero and remains coveted by her jilted lover. (在这个充满曲的动作电影中,一个乡村女孩被英雄拯救出来,)

programme.title: Clans of Intrigue ((西門無恨))
programme.desc: This wuxia films swordsman hero must go against many treacherous warriors to solve the murder of three clan heads. (这部武士电影的剑手英雄必须与许多叛徒战士打架,)

programme.title: The Golden Sword ((龙门金剑))
programme.desc: After a kidnapped swordsman is surprisingly rescued by the father he had been looking for, he also learns about his mother from him. (后来,一个被绑架的剑手被他一直在寻找的父亲惊地救出来后,)

programme.title: Diau Charn ((貂蝉))
programme.desc: Set in the Han Dynasty, this drama depicts the legendary beauty Diao Chan, and how she used her charms to help her godfather eradicate corrupt court officials. (剧情设置在汉王朝, 描述了传奇美女迪亚,)

programme.title: The Black Butterfly (黑蝶)
programme.desc: A waitress, who is secretly the outlaw Black Butterfly, steals from the rich and gives to the poor but picking the wrong targets sets the law on her heels. (一位服务员,她秘密是黑蝶,偷走富人,给穷人,)

programme.title: Rose, Be My Love ((玫瑰我爱你))
programme.desc: A love rectangle lies at the heart of this romantic drama with an eve of World War II setting. Starring Kwan Shan, Li Ting. (爱情矩形是这部浪漫剧的核心,)

programme.title: Flying Guillotine 2 ((清宫大刺杀))
programme.desc: The Emperor develops a more deadly Flying Guillotine and trains a squad of women to combat the Iron Umbrella and a band of rebels. (皇帝开发了一个更致命的飞行吉洛丁,并训练一支女性队伍来对抗铁和一支叛乱分子.)

programme.title: The Delinquent ((斯文败类))
programme.desc: A hothead Wang Chung is tempted by the dark side in this coming-of-age tale which centres on c. 1970s lower-class Hong Kong teens. (这部故事中,一个热头王被黑暗面诱惑,)

programme.title: Clan of Amazons ((陆小凤传奇之绣花大盗))
programme.desc: This action-packed adventure centres on a mysterious masked highwayman who not only steals from the rich but also blinds them! (这场充满动作的冒险集中在一个神秘的蒙面的高速公路人身上,)

programme.title: My Name Aint Suzie ((花街时代))
programme.desc: A poor young woman becomes a popular bargirl in Hong Kongs gritty response to Hollywoods The World of Suzie Wong. (一个贫穷的年轻女人成为香港热门的酒吧女士.)

programme.title: Heroes Two ((英雄第二季))
programme.desc: Shaolin loyalists led by Alexander Fu Sheng and Chen Kuan Tai go up against a formidable Manchu general and his Tibetan allies. (亚历山大福和陈泉泰领导的沙龙忠实分子与一个强大的曼彻斯特将军和他的藏族盟友作战.)

programme.title: Honey Money Phony
programme.desc: Deceived by a romantic scam and burdened with a massive debt, Lin partners with con artist Ouyang to reclaim her money. Together, they defy the odds and discover an unexpected love in the process.

programme.title: Life Must Go On ((The Show Must Go On（1991年皇后乐队演唱歌曲）))
programme.desc: When the midnight gymnasium programme for wayward teenage girls is at risk of closing down due to funding, social worker Yanki puts together a dodgeball team to compete in a match to save it. (当那些反逆的青少年女孩的午夜体育馆计划因资金而面临关闭的风险时,社会工作者Yanki组建了一个球队,)

programme.title: Wild City ((野性新加坡))
programme.desc: Hong Kong director Ringo Lam returns after seven years with this action drama in which a cop-turned-bar-owner his brother are pulled into a gang war.

programme.title: Article 20 ((第二十条))
programme.desc: Prosecutor Han Ming battles a case of intentional injury, risking all for justice. In a gripping finale, he transforms it into a fight for fairness, defending what is right. (检察官汉明在一场故意伤害案件中,为正义冒着一切风险.)

programme.title: Endgame ((终局))
programme.desc: A remake from the Japanese movie Key of Life, Andy Lau, Xiao Yang and Wan Qian stars in this action comedy about the switched identities of an unsuccessful actor a professional assassin.

programme.title: Panda Plan ((熊猫计划之部落奇遇记))
programme.desc: Legendary kung fu star Jackie Chan adopts a panda names Hu Hu. When a crime syndicate places a bounty on the panda, Jackie, his agent, and Hu Hus caretaker embark on a quest to outsmart the villains. (传奇功夫明星杰基采用了一只熊猫叫胡胡. 当犯罪集团给熊猫提供奖励时,杰基,他的代理人和胡胡监护人开始寻求超越恶棍的任务.)

programme.title: Once in a Blue Moon ((望月))
programme.desc: Mei Zhens family appears to get along but harbours secrets - she struggles at work, her brother hides his separation and their mother fears her past will affect them. Can they overcome these hurdles? (梅斯家人似乎很好处,但却隐藏着秘密 - - 她在工作中苦苦苦,她的兄弟隐藏了分手,他们的母亲担心她的过去会影响他们.)

programme.title: Man On the Edge ((边缘行者))
programme.desc: A triad leader assigns his right-hand man Ah Lok to take charge of the drug trafficking business, but Ah Lok is actually an undercover policeman who unveils a shocking political conspiracy. (一位三级领袖将他的右手阿洛克派去负责毒品贩运业务,)

programme.title: Good Game ((高手过招))
programme.desc: A desperate internet cafe owner recruits his daughter, a washed-up action star and a failed pro gamer to form a ragtag esports teamall for a HK500k tournament and one last, no-regrets shot. (一位绝望的互联网咖啡馆老板招募了他的女儿,一个流的动作明星和一个失败的职业游戏玩家,)

programme.title: The Prosecutor ((辩护))
programme.desc: A young man is wrongly convicted of drug trafficking. A former cop turned prosecutor believes in his innocence and launches an investigation, risking his life and career to find the true perpetrator. (一个年轻人被错误地判有罪,因为贩毒,一名前警察变成了检察官,相信他无辜,并开始调查,冒着生命和职业生涯的危险,)

programme.title: Time Still Turns the Pages ((年少日记))
programme.desc: High school teacher Cheng finds a suicide note, triggering his childhood memories. He strives to prevent the suicide tragedy, while dealing with his wifes divorce request and his fathers illness. (高中老师发现了一张自杀笔记,激起了他的童年记忆.他努力防止自杀悲剧,同时处理他的妻子离婚请求和父亲的疾病.)

programme.title: Tiger Wolf Rabbit ((浴火之路))
programme.desc: Three devastated parents unite after their children are abducted. Driven by grief and rage, they hunt down a brutal trafficking syndicate to bring their children home alive.

programme.title: The Narrow Road ((深入北方的小路))
programme.desc: The owner of a small cleaning company, Chak, experiences a tough time during the pandemic. When he employs single mother Candy as his assistant, she became his saving grace. (克是一家小清洁公司的老板,他在疫情期间经历了艰难的时刻.)

programme.title: Go For Broke ((重生))
programme.desc: With his family destroyed by drug dealers, Zhang Yao teams up with detective An to take down the drug lords. As the revenge plot unfolds, do they share a common foe or harbour personal agendas? (张和安侦探合作,打倒毒品主宰.)

programme.title: 97 Aces Go Places ((最佳拍档之醉街拍档))
programme.desc: When the reluctant son of a gangster is summoned home to avenge his fathers death, he enlists his fathers always-drunk bodyguard to help him out. (当一个反抗的帮派的儿子被召回家报复父亲的死亡时,他招募了父亲的身保卫,)

programme.title: A Guilty Conscience ((沈默杀机))
programme.desc: The highest grossing Chinese movie in Hong Kong history, the story tells of a barrister who swears to prove his clients innocence, going against one of the most powerful families in Hong Kong. (香港史上最钱的中国电影, 故事讲述了一个律师, 发誓要证明他的客户是无辜的,)

programme.title: The Panda Plan: Magical Tribe ((熊猫计划之部落奇遇记))
programme.desc: Superstar Jackie Chan and panda Hu Hu are ambushed by robbers during their journey. In the chaos, they plunge off a cliff and discover a mysterious, isolated tribe hidden from the outside world.

programme.title: Leap ((时空怪客))
programme.desc: At the 2008 Beijing Olympics, former volleyball legend Lang Ping coached Team USA to a controversial win over China. She later returned to rebuild Chinas team and won gold at Rio 2016.

programme.title: Over My Dead Body ((死尸死时四十四))
programme.desc: When an unidentified corpse is found at a residential unit, the residents fear that its presence will turn their home into an ill-fated house, leading to a chaotic endeavor to remove the body. (当一个不识别的尸体在住宅区被发现时,居民担心它的存在将使他们的家变成一个不幸的房子,)

programme.title: Inner Senses ((异度空间))
programme.desc: Haunted by recurring visions stemming from past traumas, Yan seeks help from psychiatrist Dr Jim. As she heals, Jim is haunted by the same disturbances when his suppressed memories resurface. (随着她愈合,吉姆也被那些被压抑的记忆重新浮现时的疾病困扰.)

programme.title: Caught In Time ((除暴·独家纪录片))
programme.desc: Based on a string of real robberies and murder cases, a detective engages in a mouse-and-cat game with the Eagle Gang, a group of sophisticated, well-trained and ruthless robbers. (根据一系列真实抢劫和谋杀案,一名侦探与队,一群复杂,训练有素和无情的强盗,进行鼠标与猫游戏.)

programme.title: The Kid From The Big Apple 2: Before We Forget ((当我们在一起))
programme.desc: Sarah and her mother return to Malaysia to spend time with her retired grandfather. When they discover his early signs of dementia, they face the challenges together while cherishing their moments. (萨拉和她的母亲回到马来西亚,和她退休的祖父在一起.)

programme.title: Flashover ((惊天救援))
programme.desc: Based on a true story, an earthquake causes the gas pipes in an industrial park to break, resulting in explosions fires in the area. Firefighters must fight to safeguard lives, including their own.

programme.title: Chinas Food Culture Ep02 (中国食品文化 Ep02)
programme.desc: Food connects people! A feast for the eyes that spotlights the cuisines of China in a way thats bound to set the mouths of the whole globe watering! (食物连接着人们! 一个眼睛盛宴,以一种方式突出中国的美食,)

programme.desc: The youth of a country is the future of that country. A series of documentaries focusing on the younger generation of China in which you get to see what they are achieving and what makes them tick! (纪录片系列讲述中国年轻人,)

programme.title: Murder at the Hotel

programme.title: The Mother Flip S1 Ep08
programme.desc: Rebecca and Kristy get a hot tip about a former rental property on the outskirts of Austin. Within city limits and close to the airport, the ranch-style home definitely has a country feel.

programme.title: Oceanfront Property Hunt S1 Ep16 (海洋前物业猎 S1 Ep16)

programme.desc: The friendship of three sworn brothers, Zhang, Huang and Ma ends when Ma gives in to corruption and falls for Huangs wife, eventually leading to a bloody ending.

programme.title: Moods Of Love
programme.desc: This Song Dynasty period piece about how far one would go for love or lust has two tales. The first involves a devilish magistrate who tries to tempt a Buddhist monk out of his self-professed celibacy by hiring a pretty prostitute. The second is the tragic tale of an exploited young girl who is forced to work in an unscrupulous couples brothel.

programme.title: The Female Prince
programme.desc: Hsiaos stepmother frames her fianc Lung when he refuses to forfeit their engagement and sends him to prison. To save him, Hsiao disguises as Lung to take the Imperial exam and ranks first place. Impressed by Hsiao, the Emperor weds the Princess to him. When Hsiao comes clean on their wedding night, she persuades the Princess to follow a plan

programme.title: Duel For Gold
programme.desc: Six swordsmen, including two sisters and their husbands, a ranger and a security man, are trying to steal a million gold taels from the Fu Lai Treasury House, not knowing that one of them is actually an undercover hero. In their quest, they have to double-cross and outwit one another...

programme.title: Hong Kong Nocturne
programme.desc: This joyous, raucous, colorful tunefest showcases the little seen dancing talents of celebrated kung-fu swordswoman Cheng Pei-Pei, as one of 3 girls dancing their way to the top.

programme.title: King Gambler
programme.desc: This film was actually a lively forerunner to the gambling film craze, which eventually swept Asian cinema. Here, its cardsharp versus cardsharp with a lot more kung-fu action, in a battle of wits and fists to become the king of the casino. The double stings and triple crosses raise in complexity and imagination until what started as an unusual box office risk became a top ten hit of 1976.

programme.title: Lets Fall In Love
programme.desc: Da Yung, the son of a rich entrepreneur, meets Lian Lian, the niece of a kindergarten principal by chance. They fall into a misunderstanding on the first meeting, causing Da Yung to lose his wallet. Further misunderstanding occurs when he tries to get her to act as his fianc so as to drive away two women whom he does not like

programme.title: Magnificent Wanderers
programme.desc: Lin and his two friends are traveling patriots who vow to stand up against violence and fight for justice. They meet a rich young man Chu by chance one day and the four become best friends. When a foreign prince plots to possess Chus family fortune and goes after him, Lin and friends go all out to help Chu fight against the villain.

programme.title: We Love Millionaires
programme.desc: In this romantic comedy, three beautiful Hong Kong salesgirls travel to Osaka in Japan to pursue their dreams of marrying a rich man. They masquerade as high society debutantes and make their way to a posh resort to meet and woo millionaires or fake ones!.

programme.title: The Brave Archer 2
programme.desc: Knowing Guo Jing has won Huang Rongs hand in marriage using the kung fu learned from Jiu Yin manual, Ouyang Feng captures Huang and agrees to release her only if Guo can dictate the content of the manual. Will Guo give in to the threat?

programme.title: Big Times for the Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: Ah Niu finds a bag of jewels on the street and becomes rich. It is at this time that Uncle Zhou asks him to sign a contract to marry a girl, but it turns out to be a trap for Ah Niu to sell his house. In the end, Ah Niu becomes poor again

programme.title: The Crimson Charm
programme.desc: Yu Fang Fang survives the massacre of her masters family at the hands of the Crimson Charm gang but loses her arm in the process. Determined, she vows to team up with a swordsman seeking revenge against the ruthless gang.

programme.title: The Younger Generation
programme.desc: A tragic tale about a young girl who gets married and has five kids. When she and her husband die, leaving all five kids behind to fend for themselves, the eldest child is forced to be sold into prostitution to feed the other four.

programme.title: Purple Darts
programme.desc: A girl vows to take revenge for her parents who were murdered by four outlaws when she was only a baby. To do so, she trains hard at martial arts and teams up with a swordsman and a couple to finally kill them all.

programme.title: To Kill a Jaguar
programme.desc: Set in 1920s Shanghai, a village girl journeys to the big city in search of her father and meets her childhood friend Jaguar, who works for the mob boss Kam. In a world controlled by the mobs, it is a test of survival for all as Jaguar allies himself with ace gunman Ko Tang, to take over Kams empire.

programme.title: Clans of Intrigue
programme.desc: Heroic outlaw Chu Liu Xiang is dining with his friend Monk Wu Hua, when Gong from the Holy Water Palace appears and accuses Chu of stealing the holy water from her Palace and using it for various murders. Chu denies, and is given a month to find the murderer or be killed by Gong. To prove his innocence, Chu decides to investigate the case

programme.title: The Golden Sword
programme.desc: Swordsman Long meets Feng while searching for his missing father and they soon fall in love and marry. When Long is kidnapped by Dragon Gate Palace one day, Feng embarks on a rescue mission and reunites with Long, who manages to escape. Together, they confront the head of Dragon Gate Palace, and uncover a long-hidden secret.

programme.title: Diau Charn
programme.desc: In the Han Dynasty, the tyrannical Prime Minister Dong Zuo takes control of the country, so Minister Wang plots to take him down using Diau Charns beauty. Wang arranges for her to be Dongs concubine as he knows Dongs adopted son Lu Bu is in love with her, turning them against each other. Lu Bu ends up killing Dong Zuo to be with Diau Charn.

programme.title: The Black Butterfly
programme.desc: Kwan leads a double life as a waitress and as an infamous outlaw skilled in martial arts, The Black Butterfly. When she steals a cache of gold from the Five Devils Rock bandits, she soon has the bandits, and the government, on her tail.

programme.title: Rose, Be My Love
programme.desc: Not a love triangle but a love rectangle, Rose, Be My Love is a romantic drama set on the eve of World War II that represents the high standards achieved by Shaw Brothers in both aspects of star power and technical polish.

programme.title: Flying Guillotine 2
programme.desc: In a time of anti-Manchu sentiment, Emperor Yong Zheng employs his ruthless Blood Hound Corps to silence any dissenters. Only one man and his signature weapon, The Flying Guillotine, stand in their way.

programme.title: The Delinquent
programme.desc: This is a coming-of-age tale depicting the lower class Hong Kong troubled youths in the 1960s and the societal issues that they face. Wang Chung is a hotheaded and rebellious teen who is tempted by the dark side, and have to unfortunately pay a huge price for it.

programme.title: Clan of Amazons
programme.desc: The martial arts world is plunged into terror when a mysterious figure known as the Embroidery Bandit starts to attack convoys of precious materials. Seemingly unstoppable, the frightened clans decide to call on the expertise of Lu Xiao Feng, an inquisitive fighter and detective to capture the culprit.

programme.title: My Name Aint Suzie
programme.desc: Young Mei Li works as a bar girl in Wanchai to make a living. When she meets Jimmy in the bar, she thinks he is her true love and falls crazily in love with him. When Jimmy has to leave, Mei Li is devastated. It is not until she encounters the triad boss Ying that she finally found someone to count on.

programme.title: Heroes Two
programme.desc: Shaolin disciple Hong escapes from the burning temple after a Qing army attack, but suffers serious injuries while fleeing. Mistaking Hong for a dangerous outlaw, Fang captures him and hands him over to the Qing soldiers. After learning the truth, Fang does everything he can to rescue Hong, so the two can join forces against the Qing army.

programme.title: Maoshan Heavenly Master
programme.desc: Prisoner Chi flees away under Master Zhangs custody, causing the latter to be expelled from his clan. On his way to find Chi, Master Zhang arrives at a place where many people vanish for no reason. He soon discovers that it is Chi who captures them in his training to become a serpent demon. The war between human and demon has just begun!

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: Skyline Cruisers
programme.desc: Four professional thieves are tasked with stealing a cancer vaccine, but they are shocked to discover a pre-set bomb in the laboratory and realize it is a setup against them. Suddenly, a mysterious girl appears, holding a crucial clue that could unravel the conspiracy...

programme.title: Face to Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. At Tamotsus funeral, Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man and that is only the beginning of an evil downfall for him

programme.title: The Grey Men 2
programme.desc: Triad boss Song seeks to whitewash his image and seize Laikas mayoral seat amid a regime change. He faces a funding shortfall despite colluding with officials, and gets his right-hand man and enforcer to commit crimes to boost his funds and power. Just as Song believes success is imminent, the dynamics between the three take an unexpected turn

programme.title: Fate Jealous Greed
programme.desc: The film consists of three short horror stories: a man tries to survive after he received a haunted mail predicting his death while a man mourns the death of his beloved wife, she becomes a ghost and tries to communicate with him three brothers clash over the care options of their elderly mother during dinner, leading to a terrifying murder.

programme.title: Lets Make Laugh
programme.desc: When a young housewifes debt-ridden, philandering husband leaves her with a mountain of tax debts, a security guard is hired by the tax authority to guard the assets, but he starts falling for her instead.

programme.title: Paper Man
programme.desc: As the police investigate a gang murder case, another mysterious paper man murder occurs, and the suspects are killed one by one. Continuing to track the clues of the case, the police finally unveil a hidden secret and tragedy spanning two generations.

programme.title: Hidden Heroine
programme.desc: A drug cartel is entrenched in the Dong Zhou area. Mei Jing of the Thunderbolt Womens Commando Unit, leads her team to attack the drug base, but they are being ambushed and the identity of Meis father as an undercover is exposed. After a fierce battle, Mei and her team manage to successfully defeat the drug cartel and rescue her father.

programme.title: Doubles Cause Troubles
programme.desc: Two squabbling cousins find themselves in more trouble than they can imagine after their tenant ends up dead. The gangsters and the police are both after them, and they have no idea what they have done wrong!

programme.title: Love Punch
programme.desc: Talented boxer Jia Yang is caught in an underground fight to clear her fathers debts. She loses her Olympic aspiration and vanishes from the boxing world. 10 years later, Coach Li Yue is determined to help her honour her fathers wish by returning to the ring. As passion and obligation collide, can Jia Yang revive her abandoned boxing dream?

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto. Who is the real King of Thieves?

programme.title: Unmatchable Match
programme.desc: Undercover cop Lang is assigned to befriend former triad boss Fei in order to investigate a diamond heist masterminded by the ruthless gangster Big Mad. When the deal goes awry and the diamonds end up in Feis possession, Big Mad comes after them with a vengeance, forcing Lang and Fei to join forces as an unlikely bond begins to form between them.

programme.title: Oily Maniac
programme.desc: Famous director Ho Meng-hua, who gave Jackie Chan and Sammo Hung acting breaks in his early kung-fu films, broke new ground with his horror hit Oily Maniac. Based on a true story about a creature that kills people at night and covers them in oil, it stars young actor Danny Lee aka. Li Hsiu-hsien as the oily maniac. It was considered so scary that it was censored drastically.

programme.title: Fight Back to School II
programme.desc: Following his demotion, officer Sing resigns from the police force and goes undercover at an international school to privately investigate a terrorist plot. There, he discovers bumbling detective Tat posing as a teacher. Forced into an alliance, they team up to confront the heavily armed criminals behind the plot in a chaotic showdown.

programme.title: Night Watch
programme.desc: After a car accident erases his memory, Wang Ren Jie takes a job as a night guard. When the clock strikes midnight, he reports for duty at an abandoned building only to find three lost souls awaiting him, and unravels a revenge plot at the same time. Is this fate or a curse cast by vengeful spirits?

programme.title: The Comeback
programme.desc: Uncle Hua is a retired agent who owns an antique shop on an old street. When the old street is forcibly demolished by the local Green Dragon Gang one day, Uncle Huas hidden identity is accidentally revealed, and he is pursued by a mysterious organization headed by Ah Jie. A fatal duel has just begun!

programme.title: Detrimental
programme.desc: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory on an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help his other co-workers escape safely and fight to kill the monster.

programme.title: Lets Make Laugh II
programme.desc: Bodyguard Ah Sun is sent to protect his boss son, only to meet and fall in love with his mistress, the gorgeous Joey. As love blossoms between the two, the powerful boss finds out and all hell breaks loose!

programme.title: Jealousy
programme.desc: Model Min dies mysteriously in a hospital rumoured to be haunted. Soon after, her photographer receives eerie phone calls, a writer suffers a bizarre car accident, and Mins friend suddenly vanishes. As fear spreads, dark secrets and supernatural forces emerge, drawing them into a terrifying nightmare linked to Mins death.

programme.title: The Monkey is Back
programme.desc: The legendary Stone Monkey gives hope to a desperate girl by promising to change her fate. Years later, after a fierce battle against the powerful three-eyed God of War, he is defeated and cast into the mortal world. Stripped of his former glory, Stone Monkey must rise again, confront powerful enemies, and fulfil the promise he once made.

programme.title: Prince Charming
programme.desc: Chen Li Pin, the nerdy son of a business tycoon, and his friend seek love in Hawaii. Returning home in disappointment, they accidentally find themselves in a messy identity swap. It is at this time that Chen falls for a beautiful girl May, who thinks he is a company chauffeur

programme.title: Fist of Legend
programme.desc: When Chen Zhen studies in Japan, he finds several Chinese students missing and accidentally uncovers the Black Dragon Societys conspiracy. A new drug is invented to boost bodies of the Japanese troops in war and the Chinese students are used in their experiments. Chen Zhen vows to take down the evil society and destroy their secret laboratory.

programme.title: Cherie
programme.desc: Cherie Chung plays the title character in this sexy romance as a fitness instructor who attracts the attentions of a wealthy businessman and a handsome photographer.

programme.title: Initial D
programme.desc: The movie is adapted from a famous Japanese manga. 18-year-old Takumi delivers tofu in his fathers near-obsolete car every day and becomes a good racer with perfect drifting skill. Encouraged by his father, he joins a mountain race and unexpectedly wins it, making him famous overnight and leading him from one exciting race to another.

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays an arrogant god in Heaven who is being punished for his pranks and mistakes. He is sent to Earth and reincarnate as Mad Monk to change the destiny of three misguided souls - a prostitute, a beggar and a villain. The Mad Monk needs to complete the task in three days in order to return to Heaven.

programme.title: The Sorcerer The White Snake
programme.desc: In this action fantasy movie based on the Chinese legend of the White Snake, a young herbalist falls in love with a thousand-year-old white snake disguised as a woman. When the white snakes true identity is revealed, a sorcerer goes to battle believing that in doing so, he is restoring balance and order between man and the supernatural.

programme.title: Ip Man 2
programme.desc: After the Sino-Japanese war, Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Man and his family experience hardship in their hometown and eventually moved to Hong Kong for a new life. He wants to open a martial arts school in Hong Kong, but first he must pass and win the challenges put forth by the local martial arts grandmasters.

programme.title: Olivia S1 - Olivias Lemonade Stand
programme.desc: Olivias lemonade stand is losing customers to Francines pink lemonade stand. Olivia does her one better by opening up her own full-scale backyard restaurant, imagining its a fabulous supper club. But Olivia soon finds that her restaurant needs something she can only get from Francine something pink!

programme.title: Gabbys Dollhouse S1 - Dollhouse Store Day

Gabby and Pandy help out at all the different stores Cakeys Bakery, Baby Boxs Craft Emporium, Kitty Fairys Flower Shoppe to earn kitty coins and save up for a melodicat at the Grand Opening of DJ Catnips Music Store!

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - The Cleat without Feet Real Magic
programme.desc: When Phoebe accidentally knocks Harpers soccer cleat off the balcony before the big game, the Dew Drops must venture into the city to retrieve the cleat. When Dylan starts practicing magic tricks, Athena thinks his magic is real! But when the Dew Drops investigate his magic hat, they accidentally break it and must fix it before Dylans magic show for the neighborhood kids.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - The Sleepover Save The Very Hungry Vacuum
programme.desc: Marcus is having his first sleepover and Phoebe is concerned that Marcus may be nervous so Phoebe sets out to make sure he has the best first sleepover ever. When Athenas magical jump rope gets sucked up by the familys new robot vacuum, she loses confidence in her abilities, only to learn that her real abilities are already inside her.

programme.title: Gabbys Dollhouse S1 - Kitty Rangers

programme.title: Gabbys Dollhouse S1 - Meow-Mazing Games

But Gloria doesnt ask Starlene what she wants, and pushes the crabs introverted self too far, ultimately learning you have to respect your shy friends comfort levels they may be different than yours.

programme.title: Madagascar: A Little Wild S1 - The Bear Necessities

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Family Trip Great Great Grandicorn

programme.title: 温暖的甜蜜的 Warm And Sweet
programme.desc: 南飞和家宜这对好友都面临婚姻的考题：南飞的恋人陈放对婚姻犹豫不决而未能离开前妻；家宜在结婚前夕突然明白婚姻应该为爱情而非安全感南飞于是放下工作与陈放，到贫困地区帮助弱势的一群找回自信家宜与焦岳在携手进行房屋改造中产生微妙的感情千回百转，南飞与陈放家宜与焦岳，终于看清了自己的内心，收获婚姻与爱情，领悟了美好生活的真谛.

programme.title: 太平年 Swords Into PlowShares
programme.desc: 太平年描绘了一幅从旌旗猎猎的烽火中原，到市列珠玑的繁华吴越，乱世纷纭阳谋天下的五代十国史诗画卷钱弘俶赵匡胤郭荣三位有志青年经历了家国动乱秩序崩溃生灵涂炭后，逐渐认识到只有国家一统才能摆脱战火国殇郭荣在尸山血海中重拾国家秩序，壮志未酬，英雄气短；赵匡胤在历史转折之时建立北宋政权，严明军纪，改革弊政，安定民生，慎用兵戈，一扫五代丧乱之颓风，向着天下太平一步步迈进最终，在北宋统一的大势和天下黎庶的企盼面前，吴越王钱弘俶封疆献土，纳土归宋，完成了中国历史上一次伟大的统一Set during the turbulent Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period, the drama draws inspiration from a major historical turning point over a thousand years ag

programme.title: 卧底娇娃 Pretty Dangerous
programme.desc: 新型毒品粉精灵在城市蔓延，卧底警察潘奕风为彻底摧毁毒品网络，与另两名女性组成卧底小组三人分别擅长推理武术与伪装，以参加女团选秀为掩护，潜入犯罪组织在执行任务中，她们面临身份暴露的危险，但逐步揭开更大的幕后势力故事融合卧底动作与喜剧元素，在轻松与紧张交织中呈现一场惊险的缉毒行动As a new drug Pink Spirit spreads across the city, undercover officer Feng and her all-female team go undercover as girl group contestants to infiltrate a drug syndicate led by a philanthropic couple, only to uncover a larger criminal conspiracy.

programme.desc: 东张西望星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事趣闻逸事，并报导娱乐圈最新动态艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮今日突发环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家.

programme.title: 爱．回家之三代同糖 Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: 公关女皇唐万里吴若希饰独力照顾Gen Z女儿唐芯李茵彤饰，控制欲极强万里的母亲唐曹嘉冰车婉婉饰半生相夫教子，忽然觉醒，由加拿大返港，决心寻回失落时光，更搬入万里家中当年嘉冰曾因万里坚持未婚生下女儿，母女彻底闹僵，如今嘉冰却突然无预警杀入及扰乱万里的生活万里力图维持秩序，唐芯则周旋两人之间，三代同堂火花四溅，矛盾不断职场上，富二代老板空降营销大神杨帆赵浚承饰，与万里平起平坐正面交锋，万里事业与家庭同时迎来危机.

programme.title: 夫妻的博弈 Mrs. Revenge
programme.desc: 善良的幸如高海宁饰，活于丈夫施继威张颕康饰的压榨下，罹患绝症她撞破丈夫与唯一闺蜜潘雪文郭柏妍饰的奸情，争执间被推出马路惨遭车撞然而，幸如突然醒来，发现一切似乎只是场梦但当梦中场景接连应验，她意识到这或是预知梦为改写命运，幸如决心扭转梦中的悲剧幸如不仅要摆脱渣男与假闺蜜，更设法撮合二人，让雪文接手其原本的不幸她又善用梦境记忆换上亮丽外型，在职场力争上游，还和并肩作战的上司叶家谦马国明饰渐生情愫，最终开拓幸福人生！.

programme.title: 大唐迷雾 The Tang Mist
南美潮什么2 Hipster Tour - South America Sr.2
programme.desc: 梁芷佩重启南美洲之行，解锁更多拉丁国家，一趟旅程玩转四季！漫步阿根廷世遗冰川，一尝加入冰川冰块的威士忌发掘Patagonia的世外桃源，享受美景与美食转往智利复活节岛，藉单车环岛游找寻巨型石像亚马逊森林是世界最大的热带雨林，跟随原住民开展探险之旅位于厄瓜多尔的加拉帕戈斯群岛因进化论而闻名，登岛一探动物生态来到哥伦比亚，爽浸泥浆浴，再于加勒比海畅泳，顺道到访海中心的悬浮小岛，见识岛民生活.

programme.title: 娱乐头条 EXTRA
programme.desc: 每晚紧贴香港娱乐圈的消息，以至世界各地的影视娱乐新闻，报导艺人最新动态剧集和电影宣传演唱会精华颁奖礼盛况等，甚至远赴外地采访娱乐盛事追踪各地影星，专访观众熟悉的歌影视红人，让大家瞬间掌握影视娱乐圈的动态和最新消息.

programme.title: 妳不是她 Youre Just Not Her
programme.desc: 食品公司销售经理林信丁子朗饰时装店老板夏莉冯盈盈饰同居多时，爱情渐变平淡，两人对将来也存在分歧情侣间日积月累的矛盾不满一发不可收拾，林信夏莉爆发激烈争吵下引致车祸经历生死一剎后，踏实贤淑的夏莉变得热情率性，事事以林信为中心，甚至介入其圈子，为林信的姊姊林善车婉婉饰上司麦美娜姚嘉妮饰竞敌骆伟滔张颕康饰好兄弟穆家杰马贯东饰和区文黄庭锋饰带来巨大冲击！林信纵跟夏莉重拾初相识的浪漫与情愫，但眼前的她犹如判若两人，林信不禁思疑对方还是否真爱？.

programme.title: 刀下留人 Executioner, The
programme.desc: 杀人无数的刽子手叶常绿黄德斌为保护恩公的媳妇阮素心姚子羚顺利产子，将素心安顿在京城享负盛名的稳婆花蕊红邵美琪家中，因而遇上离奇命案，常绿竟以其鬼头刀救活了一条小生命，谁料这名来历不明的男婴令常绿和蕊红无故卷入朝廷的政治漩涡，一冷一热的配搭化解了一次又一次的危机，两人在患难中渐生情愫；另边厢，一对同在妓院长大的小情侣赤知秋杨明和祝小满龚嘉欣来到蕊红家，苦苦哀求常绿收知秋为刽子手的学徒，知秋其心不正，只想藉此逃脱受刑，常绿迟疑不决，一名神秘的彩戏师司马丑陈山聪出现，令各人关系陷入错综复杂，男婴身分之谜更因而被逐步揭开，但同时敲起了死神的丧钟.

programme.title: 兄弟 Fist Fight
programme.desc: 来自英国的保镖主管夏天行杨明，到港后奉命保护网络教主张非凡王浩信，顺道寻觅身世线索非凡行事张狂，还藉举办拳赛掩护窃密黑客赴港，期间屡遇险境麻烦，幸得天行一一化解事件引来火爆刑警何铁男伍允龙关注，决心全力追查原来铁男曾因一时冲动犯下不可告人的过失，性格亦渐走偏锋拳赛同时激发三人的好战天性，他们又逐渐发现彼此拥有相同的感应能力，藉以互助互救而三人背后的隐密连系，更牵涉逾二十年前的金融风暴之战.

programme.title: 巨轮 Brothers Keeper
programme.desc: 乔天生（陈展鹏饰）和罗威信（萧正楠饰）是同母异父的亲兄弟，因为命运令他们不单分开在香港和澳门两地，更令他们尝尽剧变历史中的两极冲突 母亲周玉梅（李司棋饰）带着小儿子威信在澳门当黑市居民，威信凭着努力和好朋友姚文英（田蕊妮饰）与龙飞（阮兆祥饰）的相助，历尽艰辛，克服挑战，最终踏上成功之路独自在港自食其力的天生却改走快捷方式，联结黑道古惑仔姜勇（张继聪饰），与富家女发生关系，令女友卓静（钟嘉欣饰）伤心欲绝，最终落得人财两空 本是唇齿相依的手足情，经历时代巨轮的洗礼，前境变幻莫测，二人愈走愈远，但一个信念深植在他们相连的血脉里，纵然考验再苦再难，终在一条又新又活的道路上重遇.

programme.title: 我瞒结婚了 Married But Available
programme.desc: 一场意外，令情侣欧阳梓聪及朱明明决定结婚不过，明明为免得失老板施露嘉，只得隐瞒已婚；同时，梓聪被大学同学张展博邀请，加入露嘉的公司，密谋重夺展博父张建国所创的金行业务这对隐婚夫妻被迫在公司内对立，渐生矛盾此外，展博与明明发现十分有缘，暗恋梓聪十多年的纪文意，亦令梓聪抵受不了诱惑，一对夫妻各自展开婚外情明明决定分居后，梓聪却看到展博的事业诡计，加以阻止，更惹明明讨厌，两人的关系有否转机？.

programme.desc: 一场意外，令情侣欧阳梓聪及朱明明决定结婚不过，明明为免得失老板施露嘉，只得隐瞒已婚；同时，梓聪被大学同学张展博邀请，加入露嘉的公司，密谋重夺展博父张建国所创的金行业务这对隐婚夫妻被迫在公司内对立，渐生矛盾此外，展博与明明发现十分有缘，暗恋梓聪十多年的纪文意，亦令梓聪抵受不了诱惑，一对夫妻各自展开婚外情明明决定分居后，梓聪却看到展博的事业诡计，加以阻止，更惹明明讨厌，两人的关系有否转机？.

programme.title: 妳不是她 Youre Just Not Her
programme.desc: 食品公司销售经理林信丁子朗饰时装店老板夏莉冯盈盈饰同居多时，爱情渐变平淡，两人对将来也存在分歧情侣间日积月累的矛盾不满一发不可收拾，林信夏莉爆发激烈争吵下引致车祸经历生死一剎后，踏实贤淑的夏莉变得热情率性，事事以林信为中心，甚至介入其圈子，为林信的姊姊林善车婉婉饰上司麦美娜姚嘉妮饰竞敌骆伟滔张颕康饰好兄弟穆家杰马贯东饰和区文黄庭锋饰带来巨大冲击！林信纵跟夏莉重拾初相识的浪漫与情愫，但眼前的她犹如判若两人，林信不禁思疑对方还是否真爱？.

programme.title: 刀下留人 Executioner, The
programme.desc: 杀人无数的刽子手叶常绿黄德斌为保护恩公的媳妇阮素心姚子羚顺利产子，将素心安顿在京城享负盛名的稳婆花蕊红邵美琪家中，因而遇上离奇命案，常绿竟以其鬼头刀救活了一条小生命，谁料这名来历不明的男婴令常绿和蕊红无故卷入朝廷的政治漩涡，一冷一热的配搭化解了一次又一次的危机，两人在患难中渐生情愫；另边厢，一对同在妓院长大的小情侣赤知秋杨明和祝小满龚嘉欣来到蕊红家，苦苦哀求常绿收知秋为刽子手的学徒，知秋其心不正，只想藉此逃脱受刑，常绿迟疑不决，一名神秘的彩戏师司马丑陈山聪出现，令各人关系陷入错综复杂，男婴身分之谜更因而被逐步揭开，但同时敲起了死神的丧钟.

programme.title: 兄弟 Fist Fight
programme.desc: 来自英国的保镖主管夏天行杨明，到港后奉命保护网络教主张非凡王浩信，顺道寻觅身世线索非凡行事张狂，还藉举办拳赛掩护窃密黑客赴港，期间屡遇险境麻烦，幸得天行一一化解事件引来火爆刑警何铁男伍允龙关注，决心全力追查原来铁男曾因一时冲动犯下不可告人的过失，性格亦渐走偏锋拳赛同时激发三人的好战天性，他们又逐渐发现彼此拥有相同的感应能力，藉以互助互救而三人背后的隐密连系，更牵涉逾二十年前的金融风暴之战.

programme.desc: 来自英国的保镖主管夏天行杨明，到港后奉命保护网络教主张非凡王浩信，顺道寻觅身世线索非凡行事张狂，还藉举办拳赛掩护窃密黑客赴港，期间屡遇险境麻烦，幸得天行一一化解事件引来火爆刑警何铁男伍允龙关注，决心全力追查原来铁男曾因一时冲动犯下不可告人的过失，性格亦渐走偏锋拳赛同时激发三人的好战天性，他们又逐渐发现彼此拥有相同的感应能力，藉以互助互救而三人背后的隐密连系，更牵涉逾二十年前的金融风暴之战.

programme.title: 巨轮 Brothers Keeper
programme.desc: 乔天生（陈展鹏饰）和罗威信（萧正楠饰）是同母异父的亲兄弟，因为命运令他们不单分开在香港和澳门两地，更令他们尝尽剧变历史中的两极冲突 母亲周玉梅（李司棋饰）带着小儿子威信在澳门当黑市居民，威信凭着努力和好朋友姚文英（田蕊妮饰）与龙飞（阮兆祥饰）的相助，历尽艰辛，克服挑战，最终踏上成功之路独自在港自食其力的天生却改走快捷方式，联结黑道古惑仔姜勇（张继聪饰），与富家女发生关系，令女友卓静（钟嘉欣饰）伤心欲绝，最终落得人财两空 本是唇齿相依的手足情，经历时代巨轮的洗礼，前境变幻莫测，二人愈走愈远，但一个信念深植在他们相连的血脉里，纵然考验再苦再难，终在一条又新又活的道路上重遇.

programme.title: 我瞒结婚了 Married But Available
programme.desc: 一场意外，令情侣欧阳梓聪及朱明明决定结婚不过，明明为免得失老板施露嘉，只得隐瞒已婚；同时，梓聪被大学同学张展博邀请，加入露嘉的公司，密谋重夺展博父张建国所创的金行业务这对隐婚夫妻被迫在公司内对立，渐生矛盾此外，展博与明明发现十分有缘，暗恋梓聪十多年的纪文意，亦令梓聪抵受不了诱惑，一对夫妻各自展开婚外情明明决定分居后，梓聪却看到展博的事业诡计，加以阻止，更惹明明讨厌，两人的关系有否转机？.

programme.title: 妳不是她 Youre Just Not Her
programme.desc: 食品公司销售经理林信丁子朗饰时装店老板夏莉冯盈盈饰同居多时，爱情渐变平淡，两人对将来也存在分歧情侣间日积月累的矛盾不满一发不可收拾，林信夏莉爆发激烈争吵下引致车祸经历生死一剎后，踏实贤淑的夏莉变得热情率性，事事以林信为中心，甚至介入其圈子，为林信的姊姊林善车婉婉饰上司麦美娜姚嘉妮饰竞敌骆伟滔张颕康饰好兄弟穆家杰马贯东饰和区文黄庭锋饰带来巨大冲击！林信纵跟夏莉重拾初相识的浪漫与情愫，但眼前的她犹如判若两人，林信不禁思疑对方还是否真爱？.

Tetapi apa yang mereka tidak sedar adalah kubur ini terkutuk, dan apabila azimat itu dipisahkan daripada tuannya, dia akan melakukan apa sahaja untuk mendapatkannya kembali. Pada masa yang sama, hobi Adam yang kelihatan tidak berbahaya tidak lama kemudian menjadi lebih gelap apabila dia mengintip Iva, seorang wanita muda dari Borneo. Terpesona olehnya, dia tidak lama lagi terjerat dalam rangkaian misteri dan pembunuhannya. Ketika Adam diseret lebih jauh ke dalam dunia puak Iva dan Man menyelidiki penyiasatannya dengan lebih mendalam, mereka menemui mistik bawah tanah bomoh dan makhluk ghaib di bandar itu.

programme.desc: Cinta ditolak kerana pangkat dan darjat, Si Luncai, sang pengembala kambing pergi dengan harapan yang hancur. Dirinya yang lurus dipermainkan oleh Ketua Kampung - namun kejadian tersebut telah membawanya ke seorang nenek kebayan yang telah mengubah hidupnya. Si Luncai menyamar menjadi tukang tabib dan mempermainkan semula Ketua Kampung itu. Berjayakah rancangan Si Luncai untuk mendapatkan cintanya?

programme.title: Suci Dalam Debu
programme.desc: Roy, seorang anak kaya yang ingin berkawan dengan pemuzik bertemu Rina di sebuah kelab malam. Namun, Rina telah ditunangkan dengan Tengku Johan oleh bapanya, Tengku Aziz. Tengku Johan ingin mempercepatkan tarikh perkahwinan mereka kerana ingin memiliki Rina. Roy telah dicabar dan diletakkan taruhan oleh Tengku Johan jika benar dia boleh mendapatkan Rina.

programme.title: Sindrom Mana Anakku
programme.desc: Dr. Kamal dan Dr. Lisa bekerja di hospital yang sama. Dr. Kamal keluar mendapat panggilan kecemasan di sebuah rumah. Dibawa pesakit tersebut ke hospital kerana kemungkinan komplikasi kelahiran namun mula tertanya-tanya di manakah anaknya. Anak pesakit tersebut perlu dicari sebelum apa-apa berlaku kepadanya.

programme.title: Antara Dua Hati
programme.desc: Datin Sharifah ialah seorang balu yang mempunyai dua orang anak remaja, Shah dan Ina. Shah mempunyai seorang teman wanita berbangsa Cina yang bernama Linda dan Ina pula bercinta dengan Johari. Dalam satu kemalangan, Datin Sharifah telah berkenalan dengan Jefri, seorang penyanyi kelab malam. Hubungan mereka kemudiannya menjadi semakin intim. Dalam masa yang sama, Ina pula jatuh cinta dengan Jefri.

programme.title: Bisikan Remaja
programme.desc: Ameera yang baru berpindah dari Sabah ke Kuala Lumpur bersekolah di kolej swasta, dan dipilih sebagai ketua kelas. Rakan-rakan Daniel bagaimanapun merasakan bahawa Daniel, sebagai ahli sukan kolej, lebih layak untuk jawatan itu. Ketidakpuasan hati ini memecahkan kelas kepada dua puak. Ameera semakin popular kerana kecantikan, kecerdasan dan personalitinya. Daniel membuat taruhan dengan rakan-rakannya, bahawa dia akan dapat memenangi hati Ameera dalam masa dua minggu. Apabila Ameera mengetahui tentang pertaruhan itu, dia dan Daniel menjadi musuh, walaupun telah membina perasaan bersama antara satu sama lain.

programme.title: Bayangan Cinta
programme.desc: Pertemuan dua bekas kekasih, Auzy dan Akhbar selepas 18 tahun membangkitkan perasaan lama. Walau perasaan cinta masih kuat, hubungan mereka tidak dapat diteruskan kerana Akhbar sudah pun berkahwin. Suratan takdir mengatakan sebaliknya apabila Auzy kini mengajar anak kepada Akhbar, Andy.

programme.title: Si Jantung Hati
programme.desc: Dua adik beradik, Do dan Re, keluar menggembara untuk mencari harta pusaka kepunyaan ayah mereka yang telah lama disembunyikan. Sebelum itu, mereka perlu mencari sahabat lama ayah mereka yang mempunyai petunjuk lokasi harta itu. Tetapi sesuatu terjadi apabila musuh lama muncul kembali untuk mengambil harta pusaka itu kerana yakin bahawa itu miliknya yang telah dicuri ayah mereka bertahun-tahun dahulu.

programme.title: Operasi Cegah Jenayah
programme.desc: Dua orang anggota polis, Shah dan Din telah ditugaskan untuk mengawasi satu pertunjukan permata berlian yang bernilai jutaan ringgit. Pihak penganjur juga meminta mereka berdua menjaga para peragawati mereka yang sedang bercuti daripada pertunjukan itu. Dalam masa yang sama, Crystal yang menjadi pengurus agensi peragawati itu merancang satu rompakan barangan berharga yang berada dalam pengawasan Shah dan Din.

programme.title: Manis Manis Sayang
programme.desc: Terkesan dengan tingkah laku Bahadom terhadapnya di khalayak ramai, Jalil membuat keputusan untuk berhenti bekerja. Namun Bahadom mempunyai rancangan lain apabila Datuk menyuruhnya untuk mencari seorang pegawai untuk dihantar ke luar negara. Kerana bencikan Jalil dan juga ingin memisahkannya dari Rosnah, Bahadom mahu menghantar Jalil ke luar negara.

programme.title: Suara Kekasih
programme.desc: Percintaan yang ditentang keluarga kerana perbezaan darjat membuatkan Ayu dan Taufiq terpaksa membawa haluan berbeza. Ayu, penyanyi di kelab malam jatuh cinta dengan Taufiq, pengurus syarikat insuran yang berasal dari keluarga kaya. Ditentang oleh ibu Taufiq, mereka merasakan restu keluarga amat penting dan terpaksa membuat keputusan penting untuk masa depan mereka.

programme.title: Mars Met Venus Part Cowo
programme.desc: Mengisahkan dari sudut pandang Kelvin, seorang lelaki yang cuba memahami pasangannya, Mila, menjelang hari perkahwinan mereka. Perbezaan cara berfikir, komunikasi dan harapan antara lelaki dan wanita mencetuskan pelbagai konflik serta situasi lucu. Filem ini menggambarkan bagaimana pasangan perlu memahami, bertolak ansur dan menerima kekurangan masing-masing dalam membina hubungan yang lebih erat.

programme.title: Ruang Temu
programme.desc: Program temu bual bersama Tony Eusoff yang mengupas pengalaman peribadi beliau berkaitan pengalaman beliau di dalam industri seni

programme.title: Mars Met Venus Part Cewe
programme.desc: Mengisahkan tentang Mila, seorang wanita yang mempunyai pandangan tersendiri mengenai hubungan dan cinta, yang berdepan dengan perbezaan cara berfikir antara lelaki dan wanita. Melalui kisah percintaan Mila dan Kelvin, filem ini memaparkan konflik, salah faham serta sisi lucu dalam hubungan pasangan sebelum melangkah ke alam perkahwinan.

programme.title: Mikado
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Mikado dan Laetitia, pasangan yang hidup bersama anak-anak mereka, Nuage dan Zphir, dengan cara hidup bebas di dalam van sambil mendidik anak-anak mereka sendiri. Apabila van mereka rosak, mereka terpaksa tinggal sementara di sebuah rumah bersama Vincent dan anak perempuannya. Perubahan gaya hidup ini mula menguji hubungan keluarga, membuka kisah silam serta memaksa mereka memahami erti kestabilan, kasih sayang dan kebahagiaan sebenar.

programme.title: Tayangan Perdana Bisikan Pontianak
programme.desc: Selepas ditinggalkan suaminya, Suraya Diana Danielle membesarkan dua orang anaknya sendirian di sebuah rumah terpencil. Namun apabila bekas suaminya Remy Ishak kembali untuk menuntut tanah warisan, kejadian-kejadian aneh mula menghantui kampung mereka, memaksa keluarga itu berdepan dengan rahsia silam yang selama ini tersembunyi. Tayangan Perdana ini menampilkan babak pembukaan Bisikan Pontianak, bersama rakaman eksklusif di sebalik tabir dan treler rasmi.

programme.title: Pintu Surga Terakhir
programme.desc: Irma, seorang wanita karier yang sukses dan banyak menolak lamaran lelaki demi menjaga ayahnya yang ia anggap sebagai pintu menuju surga selepas kematian ibunya. Suatu hari, tanpa sengaja dia bertemu kembali dengan Yusuf, seorang fotografer dari masa lalunya yang menghilang tanpa kabar. Pertemuan itu membangkitkan kembali hubungan mereka, tetapi Irma harus memilih antara cinta dan tanggungjawabnya terhadap ayahnya yang semakin tua.

programme.title: Pelangi Yang Hilang

programme.desc: Mengisahkan Raziah, seorang suri rumah yang menjadi wanita berdikari dan penyara keluarga selepas kematian suaminya. Tidak mahu pasrah, Raziah berusaha mencari pekerjaan dan membina kejayaan demi memulihkan rasa hormat komuniti terhadapnya.

programme.title: KIL
programme.desc: Akil, seorang pemuda yang bergelut dengan kemurungan, berkali-kali gagal membunuh diri. Hidupnya berubah apabila dia secara tidak sengaja menyelamatkan seorang gadis yang cuba terjun kerana putus cinta. Suatu hari, dia menemui risalah menawarkan khidmat bunuh diri dan menghubungi Salina, yang membawanya kepada sebuah agensi misteri bernama Life Action Bureau LAB. Di bawah bimbingan konsultan LAB, Encik Harun, Akil mengupah mereka untuk membunuhnya namun dengan syarat dia tidak akan tahu siapa pembunuhnya, bila, atau bagaimana dia akan menemui ajalnya. Segala-galanya kini menjadi permainan maut yang penuh teka-teki.

programme.desc: Alya dan Alyssa ialah pasangan kembar yang terpisah sejak lahir. Selepas 25 tahun, takdir menemukan mereka semula, dan mereka terkejut melihat wajah yang begitu seiras. Pertemuan itu merapatkan hubungan mereka, namun tanpa disedari pelbagai rahsia dan konflik mula terbongkar, mengubah kehidupan kedua-duanya.

William membantu Kimi mendapatkan pekerjaan. Samuel, sahabat Kimi di Indonesia, merasakan Kimi semakin dekat dengan William. Namun, Kimi menyangkal perkara itu. Hakikatnya, Kimi telah menyimpan perasaan kepada Samuel sejak lama.

programme.title: Bulan Terbelah di Hati Mas Silver
programme.desc: Fikri, seorang lelaki tampan dan sederhana yang sedang mencari pekerjaan. Suatu hari, dia ditawarkan oleh rakannya untuk berkerja sebagai manusia silver. Walaupun pada awalnya, dia ragu, Fikri akhirnya menerima tawaran tersebut kerana memerlukan duit. Namun, pada waktu pertama kali bekerja, Fikri telah tertangkap dan berkenalan dengan Bulan, seorang komandan Satpoll PP yang cantik namun tegas. Meskipun pekerjaan mereka sangat berbeza, benih cinta mulai tumbuh antara mereka.

programme.title: THE ROUNDUP: NO WAY OUT (没有办法出门)

programme.title: DONT GO TOO FAR (不要太远)
programme.desc: While arguing on the division of their fathers ?2B inheritance, the eldest brother received a call to realize his son was kidnapped, and the ransom demanded was ?2B...

programme.desc: A groom-to-be sets off with his friend to finding a new owner for his puppy. (一位新郎和朋友一起去找一个新主人给他的狗.)

programme.title: HI-FIVE

programme.title: KILLING ROMANCE ((大内密探之姻缘劫))
programme.desc: As a popular actress has growing discontentment towards her marriage, she begins planning to kill her rich husband with her neighbor. (由于一个受欢迎的女演员对她的婚姻越来越不满,)

programme.title: MAMA ((妈妈))
programme.desc: A story of Dong-sook, a mom with incurable illness and her son has fatal disease, Eun-sook, whose dreams eclipsed by her mom and Seung-chul, a gangster tries to find his moms first love. (故事讲述了东苏克,一个母亲患有不可治愈的疾病,她的儿子患有致命的疾病, 苏克,她的梦想被她的母亲和楚尔罩着,)

programme.title: IN OUR PRIME ((普通男女))

programme.title: MY DAUGHTER IS A ZOMBIE ((我和我的僵尸女儿))
programme.desc: Jung-hwans daughter, Soo-ah, is infected with a zombie virus. He notices that she still seems to understand words, so he draws on his experience with animal training to guide his zombie daughter.

programme.desc: While under the influence of alcohol, an unsuccessful comic book writer draws a comic about his life as a former NIS hitman, and runs into trouble when it gets posted online. (一位失败的漫画作家在酒精的影响下画了一幅漫画,讲述了他作为前NIS杀手的人生,)

programme.title: Hipster Tour - South America Sr.2 ((南美潮什么 Sr.2))
programme.desc: Christy Leung restarts her South American journey, unlocking more Latin American countries and experiencing all four seasons in one trip! Stroll along Argentinas World Heritage glaciers and sample whiskey infused with glacial ice. Discover the idyllic paradise of Patagonia, enjoying its stunning scenery and delicious cuisine. Head to Easter Island in Chile, cycling around the island in search of giant stone statues. In Colombia, soak in a mud bath, swim in the Caribbean Sea, and visit a floating island in the middle of the ocean to witness the islanders lives.

programme.title: Story of Kunning Palace ((100万个约定之宁安如梦))
programme.desc: Jiang Xue-ning Bai Lu went to great lengths to become the Empress. But she was forced to take her own life in the palace. Fast forward to the present, and Jiang Xue-nings wish is to stay away from power struggles and control her destiny. However, she still somehow enters the palace as a study partner and becomes Master Xie Weis Zhang Linghe pupil. While learning from Xie Wei, Jiang Xue-ning plots to prevent Yan Lin Zhou Junwei from getting involved in the coming-of-age incident. By following Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Weis strategy, the Yans manage to stay alive. After the coming-of-age crisis, Jiang Xue-ning unwittingly gets embroiled in the imperial court crackdown on Lord Pingnan rebels scheme. She and Zhang Zhe Wang Xingyue venture into enemy territory. At the critical moment, Jiang Xue-ning uses her body to shield arrows for Zhang Zhe. But the duo eventually cannot stay together. Hostile the State of Yue launches an invasion. First Princess Shen Zhi-yi Liu Xening does not hesitate to go down the road to making peace by marriage. To save her buddy Shen Zhi-yi, Jiang Xue-ning goes with Xie Wei to the north to deal with the State of Yue. While overcoming difficulties, Xie Wei does not mind getting hurt as he protects Jiang Xue-ning. The duo gradually have affectionate feelings for each other. However, an even more evil conspiracy gradually surfaces, and it astonishingly points to the truth about the Lord Pingnan incident from twenty years ago. Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei eventually team up to uncover the truth from yesteryear. Jiang Xue-ning also uses love to influence Xie Wei. The couple eventually find happiness. (江宁·白卢为成为皇帝做了很大的努力.但她被迫在宫殿中自杀.快速前进到现在,江宁的愿望是远离权力斗争,控制她的命运.然而,她仍然是某种程度上进入宫殿作为学习伙伴,成为伟先生的学生.在学习时,江宁阴谋阻止延周军在成年事件中参与.通过遵循江宁和徐伟战略,延们设法保持活着.在成年危机后,江宁无意地卷入了王朝的阴谋与伟王主张强的反抗.然而,她和伟王妃在成年后,最终会在伟王朝的两人之间进行和平,并最终无法在两人之间进行更深入的关系.但在两年后,)

programme.title: Scam Alert! (骗局警报!)
programme.desc: The number of various scams continues to rise, with the amounts involved becoming increasingly staggering. It is reported that Hong Kong suffers an average daily loss of HK25 million, with a scam occurring every 13 minutes Scams targeting online shopping, job seeking, investment, dating apps, and telephone scams are becoming increasingly sophisticated. Citizens must raise their awareness of scams and be vigilant to avoid falling victim! programme.title: Mrs. Revenge ((夫妻的博弈))
programme.desc: Kind-hearted Hang-yu Samantha Ko suffers from some terminal illness as she just exists under the tyranny of her husband Sze Kai-wai Jonathan Cheung. She catches her husband having an affair with her only buddy Poon Suet-man Rosita Kwok, and while arguing, she is pushed into the road and tragically hit by a car. However, Hang-yu abruptly wakes up and realizes everything seems to be just a dream. But as the scenes in her dream come true one after another, she thinks this might be a premonition. To rewrite destiny, Hang-yu is determined to turn the bad luck around in her dream. Hang-yu not only wants to get rid of that scumbag and her fake buddy, but also tries to bring the two together so that Suet-man can take over her original misfortune. Moreover, she makes good use of her dream memories and undergoes a glamorous makeover to strive for success in the workplace. She also gradually develops romantic feelings for her boss Yip Ka-him Kenneth Ma, with whom she is fighting side by side, and eventually finds happiness! (善良的心情的杭萨曼塔科患有某种终结性疾病,因为她只是在丈夫谢凯瓦伊乔纳森的暴政下存在.她发现丈夫和她唯一的朋友普恩苏特曼罗西塔·奎克发生了外遇,在争论时,她被推到道路上,并被车车车悲剧地撞击.然而,杭突然醒来,意识到一切似乎只是一个梦.但随着她的梦中的场景逐渐实现,她认为这是一个预见.为了重写命运,杭决心扭转她的梦中的不幸.杭不仅想摆脱那个丑和她的假朋友,而且还试图把两个人一起来,以便苏特曼能够接管她的不幸.她最终在梦中使用自己的梦想,并逐渐发展了幸福感,她和凯瑟琳一起)

Explore the Amazon rainforest, the worlds largest tropical rainforest, with an adventure alongside the indigenous people. Visit the Galapagos Islands in Ecuador, famous for their evolutionary history, and explore their animal ecology. In Colombia, soak in a mud bath, swim in the Caribbean Sea, and visit a floating island in the middle of the ocean to witness the islanders lives.

programme.title: Dolce Vita 2022 ((港生活·港享受 2022))
programme.desc: Hong Kong life is vibrant and diverse, and Hong Kong Life, Hong Kong Enjoyment presents both sophisticated and elegant lifestyles and down-to-earth, high-quality experiences. The program combines diverse themes, exploring different areas in each episode and inviting elites from various industries to share their secrets to success. (香港生活充满活力和多样性,香港生活,香港愉悦呈现了复杂和优雅的生活方式和实在的,高质量的体验.该节目结合了各种主题,探索了每个集中的不同领域,并邀请了来自不同行业的精英分享成功的秘密.)

programme.title: Lo And Behold ((爱·回家之开心速递))
programme.desc: HUNG SHU-KAN Lau Dan built his own logistics business from scratch and now everything is in order. The only thing on his mind is the well-being of his three daughters. His eldest daughter has moved abroad, but his second youngest daughter, HUNG YUEK-SHU

programme.title: Big Boys Club ((Big Boys Club兄弟幫 - 外星來客))
programme.desc: Big Boys Club is a youth talk show hosted by a group of close friendsBob Lam, Oscar Leung, Derek Wong, Philip Fan, and Alan Chan. In each episode, singers, entertainers, or guests from various fields are invited for relaxed interviews, presenting a wide range of topics including current social issues, pop culture, and trending interests. Matters of love, relationships, and even same-sex relationships are endlessly discussed topics for men and women alike. The show invites guests from diverse backgrounds to explore love and relationships, delving into the dynamics between the sexes. The Other Dimension segment features guests sharing extraordinary experiences, such as encounters with ghosts, UFOs, and bizarre happenings, bringing thrilling topics to the audience. (大男孩俱乐部是一款由一群亲密朋友Bob Lam,Oscar Leung,Derek Wong,Philip Fan和Alan Chan主办的青年谈话节目.在每个集中,歌手,演员或来自不同领域的客人都被邀请进行放松的面试,介绍了包括当前社会问题,流行文化和流行兴趣在内的广泛的主题.爱情,关系甚至同性关系等问题是不止讨论的主题.该节目邀请来自不同背景的客人探索爱情和关系,深入性别之间的动态.其他维度段有客人分享非凡的经验,如遇到鬼魂,UFO和奇怪事件,将兴奋的主题带到观众.)

programme.title: Story of Kunning Palace ((100万个约定之宁安如梦))
programme.desc: Jiang Xue-ning Bai Lu went to great lengths to become the Empress. But she was forced to take her own life in the palace. Fast forward to the present, and Jiang Xue-nings wish is to stay away from power struggles and control her destiny. However, she still somehow enters the palace as a study partner and becomes Master Xie Weis Zhang Linghe pupil. While learning from Xie Wei, Jiang Xue-ning plots to prevent Yan Lin Zhou Junwei from getting involved in the coming-of-age incident. By following Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Weis strategy, the Yans manage to stay alive. After the coming-of-age crisis, Jiang Xue-ning unwittingly gets embroiled in the imperial court crackdown on Lord Pingnan rebels scheme. She and Zhang Zhe Wang Xingyue venture into enemy territory. At the critical moment, Jiang Xue-ning uses her body to shield arrows for Zhang Zhe. But the duo eventually cannot stay together. Hostile the State of Yue launches an invasion. First Princess Shen Zhi-yi Liu Xening does not hesitate to go down the road to making peace by marriage. To save her buddy Shen Zhi-yi, Jiang Xue-ning goes with Xie Wei to the north to deal with the State of Yue. While overcoming difficulties, Xie Wei does not mind getting hurt as he protects Jiang Xue-ning. The duo gradually have affectionate feelings for each other. However, an even more evil conspiracy gradually surfaces, and it astonishingly points to the truth about the Lord Pingnan incident from twenty years ago. Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei eventually team up to uncover the truth from yesteryear. Jiang Xue-ning also uses love to influence Xie Wei. The couple eventually find happiness. (江宁·白卢为成为皇帝做了很大的努力.但她被迫在宫殿中自杀.快速前进到现在,江宁的愿望是远离权力斗争,控制她的命运.然而,她仍然是某种程度上进入宫殿作为学习伙伴,成为伟先生的学生.在学习时,江宁阴谋阻止延周军在成年事件中参与.通过遵循江宁和徐伟战略,延们设法保持活着.在成年危机后,江宁无意地卷入了王朝的阴谋与伟王主张强的反抗.然而,她和伟王妃在成年后,最终会在伟王朝的两人之间进行和平,并最终无法在两人之间进行更深入的关系.但在两年后,)

programme.title: News At 18:30 Global View Whats On Today ((重轻参与的播客 Global View Whats On Today))
programme.desc: Jade Channel reports important local, cross-strait, and international news every afternoon at 6:30. (每天下午6点30分,Jade Channel报道了重要的当地,跨海峡和国际新闻.)

programme.title: Scoop 2026 ((2026年全国两会))
programme.desc: Scoop airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The Todays Breaking News segment keeps viewers up to date with the days hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights. (苏普在周一到周日播出,密切关注主要社会事件和有趣的故事,同时还报道了娱乐行业的最新更新,名人新闻,以及戏剧促销和幕后特色.今天 Breaking News 分类让观众了解最热门的故事.深入的特色部分探讨了公众关心的当前事件,社会和生计问题,采访相关专家以获取他们的见解.)

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter (像母亲,像女儿)
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI Jinny Ng raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM Desta Lee alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEIs mother, TONG CHO KA-BING Stephanie Che, has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly awakened and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEIs home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEIs life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, Marketing Guru YEUNG FAN Gary Chiu, is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEIs career and family are facing crises at the same time. (公共关系女王曼丽·金尼·恩独自抚养她的Z代女儿姆·杜斯塔·李,她是一个控制怪物.姆·李的母亲乔·卡·比恩·斯蒂芬·,她已经花了一半的生命支持丈夫和抚养他们的孩子.她突然醒来,她从加拿大返回香港.她决定恢复失去了时间,她搬到曼丽的家.多年前,卡·比恩和她的女儿完全失去了,因为曼丽坚持让她的女儿离婚.现在,卡·比恩突然突破了没有警告并破坏了曼丽的生活.曼丽努力保持秩序,而姆·李在这两人之间,创造了平等的职业和家庭冲突.在这三个代家庭中,他不断地陷入危机,在这个繁荣的工作中,)

programme.title: Mrs. Revenge ((夫妻的博弈))
programme.desc: Kind-hearted Hang-yu Samantha Ko suffers from some terminal illness as she just exists under the tyranny of her husband Sze Kai-wai Jonathan Cheung. She catches her husband having an affair with her only buddy Poon Suet-man Rosita Kwok, and while arguing, she is pushed into the road and tragically hit by a car. However, Hang-yu abruptly wakes up and realizes everything seems to be just a dream. But as the scenes in her dream come true one after another, she thinks this might be a premonition. To rewrite destiny, Hang-yu is determined to turn the bad luck around in her dream. Hang-yu not only wants to get rid of that scumbag and her fake buddy, but also tries to bring the two together so that Suet-man can take over her original misfortune. Moreover, she makes good use of her dream memories and undergoes a glamorous makeover to strive for success in the workplace. She also gradually develops romantic feelings for her boss Yip Ka-him Kenneth Ma, with whom she is fighting side by side, and eventually finds happiness! (善良的心情的杭萨曼塔科患有某种终结性疾病,因为她只是在丈夫谢凯瓦伊乔纳森的暴政下存在.她发现丈夫和她唯一的朋友普恩苏特曼罗西塔·奎克发生了外遇,在争论时,她被推到道路上,并被车车车悲剧地撞击.然而,杭突然醒来,意识到一切似乎只是一个梦.但随着她的梦中的场景逐渐实现,她认为这是一个预见.为了重写命运,杭决心扭转她的梦中的不幸.杭不仅想摆脱那个丑和她的假朋友,而且还试图把两个人一起来,以便苏特曼能够接管她的不幸.她最终在梦中使用自己的梦想,并逐渐发展了幸福感,她和凯瑟琳一起)

programme.title: The Tang Mist ((大唐迷雾))
programme.desc: Set during the Chuigong era of the Wu ZhouTang Dynasty, the story follows Di Renjie as he grows disillusioned with the political intrigues of Empress Wu Zetians imperial court. Leaving the capital to inspect the southern Jiangnan region, he is drawn into a series of five strange, seemingly supernatural cases (故事发生在武王朝的楚时代,迪伦杰因王妃武泽蒂安帝国宫廷的政治阴谋而感到失望.离开首都去检查江南南部地区,他被卷入了五起奇怪,看似超自然的案件.)

programme.title: Hipster Tour - South America Sr.2 ((南美潮什么 Sr.2))
programme.desc: Christy Leung restarts her South American journey, unlocking more Latin American countries and experiencing all four seasons in one trip! In Colombia, soak in a mud bath, swim in the Caribbean Sea, and visit a floating island in the middle of the ocean to witness the islanders lives.

programme.desc: Report important news about Hong Kong, cross-strait, and international affairs. Stay updated every night with the latest news from Hong Kongs entertainment industry, as well as film and entertainment news from around the world. We report on the newest developments of artists, promotions for TV series and movies, highlights from concerts, and coverage of grand award ceremonies. We even travel abroad to cover major entertainment events, track international movie stars, and conduct exclusive interviews with well-known singers, actors, and television personalities familiar to our audienceensuring you can instantly grasp the latest happenings and news in the world of film and entertainment. programme.title: Blessing of Formosa
programme.desc: The beauty of folklore is all around us in Taiwan, but we often overlook it and fail to appreciate and feel it. The aim of this program is to promote the beauty of Taiwanese folklore and bring folklore to life. This program showcases folk culture regardless of race or religion, and presents travel information in a fun way, combining easy-to-understand folk culture knowledge with the mission of passing on folk culture. The audience can learn more about folk cultural products such as handicrafts, antiques, temple folklore, as well as short stories about the gods, and information about local tourism. It is an educational and entertaining way to travel and learn about folklore.
