programme.title: The Tradition Story of Taiwan
programme.desc: The Tradition Story of Taiwan presents a series of tales and folktales in Taiwan that have been pass down from one generation to another generation.

programme.title: Honey Money Phony
programme.desc: After falling victim to a romance scam and being left with massive debt, Lin Qinglang teams up with con artist Ouyang Hui to reclaim her stolen money. As they set up an elaborate scheme against the scammers, the pair slowly develop unexpected feelings for each other amid lies, deception and twists of fate.

programme.title: Life Must Go On ((The Show Must Go On（1991年皇后乐队演唱歌曲）))
programme.desc: When the midnight gymnasium programme for wayward teenage girls is at funding risk, social worker Yanki puts together a dodgeball team to compete in a match and save it. With an ex-star athlete John as the coach, the girls realize they must face their problems and overcome their challenges instead of dodging them. Can they finally win the match?

programme.title: Wild City ((野性新加坡))
programme.desc: A cop-turned-bar-owner befriends a drunken woman at closing hours and finds himself pursued by her former lover and the thugs he employs. The chase turns deadly when the bar owners deadbeat brother and a suitcase full of cash enter the picture.

programme.title: Article 20 ((第二十条))
programme.desc: Han Ming, a prosecutor, faces a whirlwind of complications in his work and family lives: his sons clash with another student in school and his wifes intervention, as well as the strained partnerships at work. Amidst it all, a critical case challenges his sense of righteousness, and he decides to gamble everything to seek fairness and justice.

programme.title: Endgame ((终局))
programme.desc: A killer and a stage actor accidentally swapped their identities at a bathhouse. The actor must complete the killers mission while the killer thinks he is a hopeless actor after losing his memory during the accident. When the killer strives to become a successful stage actor, he also starts to recall what has happened

programme.title: Panda Plan ((熊猫计划之部落奇遇记))
programme.desc: After legendary kung fu star Jackie Chan adopts the panda Hu Hu, an international crime syndicate places a massive bounty on the bear. Joined by his agent and Hu Hus caretaker, Jackie embarks on a daring quest to outsmart the villains.

programme.title: Once in a Blue Moon ((望月))
programme.desc: Mei Zhens family appears to get along but harbours deep secrets. Mei Zhen is trapped in a dead-end job with a toxic boss, her brother hides his separation and their mother grapples with lingering guilt over her husbands departure years ago. As Mid-Autumn Festival approaches, can the family heal their wounds and find a way back to each other?

programme.title: Man On The Edge ((边缘行者))
programme.desc: On the eve of the 1997 handover, violence is rampant with triad forces causing chaos in Hong Kong. The triad gang leader assigns his right-hand man Ah Lok to take charge of the drug trafficking business. However, Ah Lok turns out to be an undercover police officer who unveils a shocking political conspiracy during the investigation.

programme.title: Good Game ((高手过招))
programme.desc: Facing skyrocketing rent and dwindling customers, a middle-aged internet caf owner assembles a ragtag team for a HK500,000 eSports tournament. He recruits his daughter, a washed-up action star and a dismissed pro gamer. What follows is an impossible battleone that finally lets these dreamers fight with no regrets. (面对房租升高和客户减少,一个中年网咖啡馆老板为一场500万港元电子竞技比赛组建了一个团队.他招募了他的女儿,一个被洗掉的动作明星和一个被解雇的专业游戏玩家.)

programme.title: Prosecutor, The ((辩护))
programme.desc: Based on a true case, young Ma Jia Jie pleads guilty to drug trafficking in exchange for a lighter sentence, as coerced by his defense lawyer. Huo Zi Hao, a former cop turned prosecutor, believes in his innocence and launches an investigation. Risking his life and career, Huo is determined to uncover the real perpetrator.

programme.title: Time Still Turns the Pages ((年少日记))
programme.desc: High school teacher Cheng recalls his violent childhood memories when he finds an anonymous suicide note in the classroom. While he has to prevent the tragedy involving a suicidal student from happening, he also has to face a series of family problems with his wife wanting to divorce him and his fathers serious illness.

programme.title: Tiger Wolf Rabbit ((浴火之路))
programme.desc: Three devastated parents, pushed to the edge by the abduction of their children, forge a fierce alliance in the barren deserts. Driven by fury and grief, they embark on a lawless, violent crusade to hunt down a brutal trafficking syndicate. Can they shatter the criminal ring and bring their children home alive?

programme.title: The Narrow Road ((深入北方的小路))
programme.desc: Chak, a small cleaning company owner, hits tough times during the pandemic. In need of an assistant, he hires a young single mother Candy, who unexpectedly helps him solve many difficulties at work. While life seems to get back on track, a series of cruel realities happen again, but they still bond together to support each other on the narrow road.

programme.title: Go for Broke ((重生))
programme.desc: A ruthless drug trafficking group has destroyed countless families due to drug addiction, including Zhang Yaos family. Vowing to take revenge, Zhang Yao teams up with Detective An to take down the drug lords. As their revenge plot unfolds, do they share a common foe or harbour personal agendas?

programme.title: 97 Aces Go Places ((最佳拍档之醉街拍档))
programme.desc: Hao Shi becomes the new triad boss after his father is killed by the pretty swindler, Ling. While professional gunman Drunken Gun is tasked to help Hao Shi take revenge, Ling is hunted by gangster Lei, from whom she has conned 2 million dollars. In the process, Hao Shi and Drunken Gun accidentally arrest Lei instead...

programme.title: A Guilty Conscience ((沈默杀机))
programme.desc: Due to the negligence of sharp-tongued barrister Adrian, his innocent client is convicted of murder and sentenced to 17 years in jail. An opportunity to appeal the case and free his client arises a few years later, but in order to right his wrong, he must fight against one of the most powerful families in Hong Kong for justice to prevail. (由于Adrian大律师的尖锐疏忽,他的无辜当事人被判犯有谋杀罪并被判处17年监禁。 几年后,他有机会上诉并释放他的当事人,但为了纠正他的错误,他必须同香港最有权势的家庭之一斗争,以伸张正义。)

programme.title: Panda Plan: The Magical Tribe ((熊猫计划之部落奇遇记))
programme.desc: Panda Hu Hu and superstar Jackie are transported to a mysterious, isolated tribe, where Hu Hu is revered as a sacred guardian. As secrets emerge, can Hu Hu save the tribe from crisis?

programme.title: Leap ((时空怪客))
programme.desc: At the 2008 Beijing Olympics, former volleyball legend Lang Ping shocked China by coaching Team USA to victory against her home nation. Years later, when Chinas womens volleyball team fell into a slump, she returned to rebuild the squad and eventually led them to a historic gold medal triumph at the Rio 2016 Olympics.

programme.title: Over My Dead Body ((死尸死时四十四))
programme.desc: This dark comedy begins with an unidentified corpse appearing at the doorstep of a residential flat. Fearing that the corpse will turn their flats into haunted flats, which will cause a drastic drop in the property value, the four families living on the same floor attempt to move the corpse away, embroiling themselves in chaos. (这部黑暗喜剧开始于一个不识别的尸体出现在一个住宅公寓的门上.担心尸体将把他们的公寓变成鬼鬼的公寓,这将导致房地产价值急剧下降,)

programme.title: Inner Senses ((异度空间))
programme.desc: Haunted by recurring visions stemming from past traumas, Yan reaches out to psychiatrist Dr Jim to restore her sanity and overcome her troubled past. Yet, as Yan gradually heals, Jim finds himself haunted by the same disturbing images, as his suppressed memories resurface. (由于被过去的创伤所带来的反复出现的视觉困扰,求精神科医生吉姆医生恢复她的头脑和克服她的烦的过去.然而,随着逐渐康复,吉姆发现自己被同样的令人不安的图像困扰,因为他的压抑的记忆重新浮出.)

programme.title: Caught In Time ((除暴·独家纪录片))
programme.desc: Based on true events, Detective Zhong Cheng leads a task force in pursuit of Eagle, a criminal gang led by Zhang Sun. Highly methodical and disciplined, the gang manages to avoid capture after each heist. A decade later, the need to stop Eagle is more urgent than ever when Zhong Cheng realizes that his time is almost up to solve the case.

programme.title: Kid from the Big Apple 2, The ((当我们在一起))
programme.desc: Sarah and her mother return to Malaysia to reunite with her retired grandfather. What begins as a warm homecoming turns bittersweet as they notice signs of dementia, with his memories and sense of self fading. As they navigate confusion and emotional strain, the family learns to support one another with patience and love. (萨拉和她的母亲回到马来西亚与退休的祖父再见.开始的热情回家变得苦,因为他们注意到痴呆症的迹象,他的记忆和自我消耗感.)

programme.title: Flashover ((惊天救援))
programme.desc: This is based on a true story. A sudden earthquake hits the gas pipes in an industrial park, triggering massive explosions and engulfing the neighbouring area in flames. When the Fire Rescue Force reaches the scene, firefighters must fight against the flames and time, as they commit to safeguard lives with their own.

programme.title: Return Of The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This sequel makes for more bittersweet laughs and heart-wrenching misfortune, as Ah Niu gets out of the jail to find his true love becoming the wife of an abusive husband, and his uncle further exploits his naive nature.

programme.title: The Blood Brothers ((The Blood 兄弟))
programme.desc: The friendship of three sworn brothers, Zhang, Huang and Ma ends when Ma gives in to corruption and falls for Huangs wife, eventually leading to a bloody ending.

programme.title: Moods Of Love ((风花雪月))
programme.desc: This Song Dynasty period piece about how far one would go for love or lust has two tales. The first involves a devilish magistrate who tries to tempt a Buddhist monk out of his self-professed celibacy by hiring a pretty prostitute. The second is the tragic tale of an exploited young girl who is forced to work in an unscrupulous couples brothel. (关于一个人会去哪里去爱情或欲望的Song王朝时期的这篇文章有两个故事.第一讲述了一个恶魔般的法官,试图通过雇佣一个漂亮的妓女,诱惑一个佛教僧侣脱离自称独身.第二讲述了一个被剥削的年轻女孩,被迫在一个无私夫妇妓院工作.)

programme.title: The Female Prince ((这个王妃有点萌))
programme.desc: Hsiaos stepmother frames her fianc Lung when he refuses to forfeit their engagement and sends him to prison. To save him, Hsiao disguises as Lung to take the Imperial exam and ranks first place. Impressed by Hsiao, the Emperor weds the Princess to him. When Hsiao comes clean on their wedding night, she persuades the Princess to follow a plan (小巧继母在她未婚夫龙龙拒绝放弃婚约并把他送进监狱时,陷害她未婚夫龙龙,小萧为了救他,伪装成龙龙,参加皇室考试,排第一。小萧受皇帝的压迫,将公主嫁给他。当小萧在新婚之夜洗干净时,她劝公主按照计划行事。)

programme.title: Duel For Gold ((火并))
programme.desc: Six swordsmen, including two sisters and their husbands, a ranger and a security man, are trying to steal a million gold taels from the Fu Lai Treasury House, not knowing that one of them is actually an undercover hero. In their quest, they have to double-cross and outwit one another...

programme.title: Hong Kong Nocturne ((香江花月夜))
programme.desc: This joyous, raucous, colorful tunefest showcases the little seen dancing talents of celebrated kung-fu swordswoman Cheng Pei-Pei, as one of 3 girls dancing their way to the top.

programme.title: King Gambler ((千王之王重出江湖))
programme.desc: This film was actually a lively forerunner to the gambling film craze, which eventually swept Asian cinema. Here, its cardsharp versus cardsharp with a lot more kung-fu action, in a battle of wits and fists to become the king of the casino. The double stings and triple crosses raise in complexity and imagination until what started as an unusual box office risk became a top ten hit of 1976. (这部电影其实是赌博电影狂欢的热门先锋,最终席卷亚洲电影院。 在这部电影中,卡斯特哈普与卡斯特哈普的对决更激烈的功夫,在一场拳击和拳击的战斗中成为赌场的国王。 双刺和三重十字架在复杂和想象力方面增加了复杂性和三倍,直到作为非同寻常的票房风险开始成为1976年的前十大打击。)

programme.title: Lets Fall In Love (让我们爱上)
programme.desc: Da Yung, the son of a rich entrepreneur, meets Lian Lian, the niece of a kindergarten principal by chance. They fall into a misunderstanding on the first meeting, causing Da Yung to lose his wallet. Further misunderstanding occurs when he tries to get her to act as his fianc so as to drive away two women whom he does not like (达是一个富有的企业家的儿子,偶然遇到了幼儿园校长的女李安.他们在第一次见面上失去了理解,导致达失去钱包.他试图让她扮演他的未婚夫,以便驱逐两个不喜欢的女人)

programme.title: Magnificent Wanderers (伟大的漫游者)
programme.desc: Lin and his two friends are traveling patriots who vow to stand up against violence and fight for justice. They meet a rich young man Chu by chance one day and the four become best friends. When a foreign prince plots to possess Chus family fortune and goes after him, Lin and friends go all out to help Chu fight against the villain.

programme.title: We Love Millionaires ((我爱金龟婿))
programme.desc: In this romantic comedy, three beautiful Hong Kong salesgirls travel to Osaka in Japan to pursue their dreams of marrying a rich man. They masquerade as high society debutantes and make their way to a posh resort to meet and woo millionaires or fake ones!. (在这部浪漫喜剧中,三个美丽的香港卖家女士前往日本大阪,追求他们嫁给一个富人的梦想.)

programme.title: The Brave Archer 2 ((射雕英雄传续集))
programme.desc: Knowing Guo Jing has won Huang Rongs hand in marriage using the kung fu learned from Jiu Yin manual, Ouyang Feng captures Huang and agrees to release her only if Guo can dictate the content of the manual. Will Guo give in to the threat? (知道郭已经通过从英手册学到的功夫赢得了黄荣的婚姻,乌阳捕获黄并同意只要郭能决定手册内容,才释放她.)

programme.title: Big Times For The Crazy Bumpkins ((阿牛发达记))
programme.desc: Ah Niu finds a bag of jewels on the street and becomes rich. It is at this time that Uncle Zhou asks him to sign a contract to marry a girl, but it turns out to be a trap for Ah Niu to sell his house. In the end, Ah Niu becomes poor again

programme.title: The Crimson Charm ((血符门))
programme.desc: Yu Fang Fang survives the massacre of her masters family at the hands of the Crimson Charm gang but loses her arm in the process. Determined, she vows to team up with a swordsman seeking revenge against the ruthless gang.

programme.title: The Younger Generation ((年青的一代))
programme.desc: A tragic tale about a young girl who gets married and has five kids. When she and her husband die, leaving all five kids behind to fend for themselves, the eldest child is forced to be sold into prostitution to feed the other four. (故事讲述了一个结婚和五个孩子的年轻女孩. 当她和丈夫去世,)

programme.title: Purple Darts ((紫金镖))
programme.desc: A girl vows to take revenge for her parents who were murdered by four outlaws when she was only a baby. To do so, she trains hard at martial arts and teams up with a swordsman and a couple to finally kill them all. (一个女孩发誓要报复她四名非法犯杀害的父母,她还是一个婴儿.)

programme.title: To Kill a Jaguar ((绝不低头))
programme.desc: Set in 1920s Shanghai, a village girl journeys to the big city in search of her father and meets her childhood friend Jaguar, who works for the mob boss Kam. In a world controlled by the mobs, it is a test of survival for all as Jaguar allies himself with ace gunman Ko Tang, to take over Kams empire. (20世纪20年代上海时,一个乡村女孩前往大城市寻找她的父亲,并会见了她童年时的朋友贾瓜尔(Jaguar ), 他为暴徒老大卡姆工作。 在暴徒控制的世界中,这是对作为 " 捷豹 " 和Ace枪手Ko Tang的盟友的所有人生存的考验,以接管卡姆斯帝国。)

programme.title: Clans of Intrigue ((西門無恨))
programme.desc: Heroic outlaw Chu Liu Xiang is dining with his friend Monk Wu Hua, when Gong from the Holy Water Palace appears and accuses Chu of stealing the holy water from her Palace and using it for various murders. Chu denies, and is given a month to find the murderer or be killed by Gong. To prove his innocence, Chu decides to investigate the case

programme.title: The Golden Sword ((龙门金剑))
programme.desc: Swordsman Long meets Feng while searching for his missing father and they soon fall in love and marry. When Long is kidnapped by Dragon Gate Palace one day, Feng embarks on a rescue mission and reunites with Long, who manages to escape. Together, they confront the head of Dragon Gate Palace, and uncover a long-hidden secret.

programme.title: Diau Charn ((貂蝉))
programme.desc: In the Han Dynasty, the tyrannical Prime Minister Dong Zuo takes control of the country, so Minister Wang plots to take him down using Diau Charns beauty. Wang arranges for her to be Dongs concubine as he knows Dongs adopted son Lu Bu is in love with her, turning them against each other. Lu Bu ends up killing Dong Zuo to be with Diau Charn. (在汉王朝,暴君总理唐祖控制了国家,因此王大臣策划用迪亚乌·查恩的美女来夺走他.王安排她成为迪亚乌·查恩的 concubine,因为他知道迪亚乌·查恩的收养儿子卢布爱上她,把他们互相反对.卢布最终杀死了东祖与迪亚乌·查恩在一起.)

programme.title: The Black Butterfly (黑蝶)
programme.desc: Kwan leads a double life as a waitress and as an infamous outlaw skilled in martial arts, The Black Butterfly. When she steals a cache of gold from the Five Devils Rock bandits, she soon has the bandits, and the government, on her tail.

programme.title: Rose, Be My Love ((玫瑰我爱你))
programme.desc: Not a love triangle but a love rectangle, Rose, Be My Love is a romantic drama set on the eve of World War II that represents the high standards achieved by Shaw Brothers in both aspects of star power and technical polish. (罗莎·贝·我的爱是一部在第二次世界大战前夕拍摄的浪漫剧,)

programme.title: Flying Guillotine 2 ((清宫大刺杀))
programme.desc: In a time of anti-Manchu sentiment, Emperor Yong Zheng employs his ruthless Blood Hound Corps to silence any dissenters. Only one man and his signature weapon, The Flying Guillotine, stand in their way.

programme.title: The Delinquent ((斯文败类))
programme.desc: This is a coming-of-age tale depicting the lower class Hong Kong troubled youths in the 1960s and the societal issues that they face. Wang Chung is a hotheaded and rebellious teen who is tempted by the dark side, and have to unfortunately pay a huge price for it. (这是一个成年故事,描绘了1960年代香港低阶级的困境青年和他们面临的社会问题.王是一个热心和叛逆的青少年,)

programme.title: Clan of Amazons ((陆小凤传奇之绣花大盗))
programme.desc: The martial arts world is plunged into terror when a mysterious figure known as the Embroidery Bandit starts to attack convoys of precious materials. Seemingly unstoppable, the frightened clans decide to call on the expertise of Lu Xiao Feng, an inquisitive fighter and detective to capture the culprit.

programme.title: My Name Aint Suzie ((花街时代))
programme.desc: Young Mei Li works as a bar girl in Wanchai to make a living. When she meets Jimmy in the bar, she thinks he is her true love and falls crazily in love with him. When Jimmy has to leave, Mei Li is devastated. It is not until she encounters the triad boss Ying that she finally found someone to count on. (年轻的梅丽在万市工作为酒吧女生,以谋生.当她在酒吧里遇到吉米时,她认为他是她的真正爱人,并疯狂地爱上他.当吉米必须离开时,梅丽很丧.直到她遇到三人团的老板,她终于找到了一个可以依靠的人.)

programme.title: Heroes Two ((英雄第二季))
programme.desc: Shaolin disciple Hong escapes from the burning temple after a Qing army attack, but suffers serious injuries while fleeing. Mistaking Hong for a dangerous outlaw, Fang captures him and hands him over to the Qing soldiers. After learning the truth, Fang does everything he can to rescue Hong, so the two can join forces against the Qing army. (门门徒洪在清军袭击后逃离燃烧的寺,但在逃跑时受到了严重伤害.误认为洪是危险的异行者,抓住他并将他交给清士兵.了解了真相后,尽一切可能拯救洪,所以两人可以联合起来对抗清军.)

programme.title: Dabangg 3
programme.desc: ASP Chulbul Pandey encounters a foe from his past after he arrests a pimp, Chinti Walia. However, he must face his demons and defeat his enemy before it is too late.

programme.title: 신중한 강연쇼
programme.desc: 5천년 중국 역사 비틀기부터 2016년 현재 중국의 민낯까지! ALL ABOUT CHINA! 지금까지 당신이 알고 있던 중국은 잊어라! 중국과 한국의 명사들에게 듣는 중국인도 모르는 중국의 진짜 이야기! quot표절 천국이냐 한류를 넘어선 콘텐츠 강국이냐, 대륙의 문화 콘텐츠의 민낯은? 슈퍼 차이나인가 차이나쇼크인가? 미래의 차이나 리포트는?quot 당신이 모르던 진짜 중국에 대한 이야기를 들려준다. 한중 대표 지식인 6인의 버라이어티 강연쇼! 같은 주제에 다른 시각 또는 각자의 관점으로 이야기 하라! 신중한 강연쇼는 통찰력으로 무장한 한국과 중국의 지성 교양인 6인이 출연하여 매회 한국 대툐와 중국 대표 강연자가 한가지 테마를 두고 강연을 펼친다. 다양한 테마는 기본, 한중 양국의 다채로운 시선과 생각을 공유할 수 있는 새로운 형식의 버라이어티 강연쇼로 시청자들에게 다가갈 수 있을 것이다.

programme.desc: 우리 민족은 기록에 관해서는 대단한 저력을 지니고 있다. 유네스코에 세계문화유산으로 지정된 조선시대의 승정원일기가 그렇고 그 사초를 바탕으로 편찬한 조선왕조실록이 그렇다. 현대 의회 민주주의의 전당, 국회에도 이러한 기록에 있다. 국민의 대표기관인 국회의 의정활동을 낱낱이 기록하는 속기록이 바로 그것. 여의도 국회 30주년을 맞아 국회방송에서는 총 16부에 걸친 연작 다큐멘터리 다시보는 속기록연출 조정훈을 제작, 방송한다. 이 프로그램은 질곡의 대한민국 현대사를 국회 속기록이라는 프리즘을 통해 재조명하고, 우리에게 주는 질책과 교훈을 담아낼 계획이다.

programme.desc: Mikmaq After months apart, a lot has changed. The group are reunited by Knowledge Keeper Caleb Musgrave who helps heal old wounds, reveal their new paths and share some life-changing secrets.

programme.title: Wolastoqey Petroglyphs to Pixels
programme.desc: Wolastoqey Delores Churchill, a renowned spruce root weaver, is one of the most respected and prolific teachers in the Pacific Northwest. She is passing on her skills to her daughter, Holly Churchill, and other students.

programme.title: Inuktitut Adventures on Inuit Land

programme.title: Inuktitut Tiiturta

programme.title: Inuktitut Nunavummi Mamarijavut

programme.title: Dene Arm Nation
programme.desc: Dene, DenesulineProvincial champion Steph Heroux faces apotentiallycareer-ending injury.Meanwhile,arm-wrestling legend VernTheOne-ArmedBandit Martelmakes his way backto the tableforthe firsttime after twoexhausting years battling stage four cancer.

programme.title: Cree Home

programme.title: Dakota Grandma Sherrys Kitchen
programme.desc: Dakota In todays episode, Grandma Sherry makes a meal thats a staple in every Indigenous kitchen. She makes her crowd-pleasing hamburger soup and fresh baked biscuits, and then she reveals how to use fresh or frozen rhubarb in her quick.

programme.title: Dakota Wild Archaeology
programme.desc: Dakota The team flies up to the spectacular Calvert Island where they meet Heiltsuk archaeologist Elroy White. Rudy explores one of the deepest shell middens ever discovered on the West Coast.

programme.title: Tutchone Yukon Harvest

programme.title: Tutchone Yukon Harvest
programme.desc: Tutchone, Northern Cree Elder, Annette, meets some old friends, including Yukon guides, Scott and Wojo, for a deer hunting trip in snowy Saskatchewan. She quickly realizes this is not just a hunting trip,but a journey of personal healing and grief.

programme.title: Tutchone Yukon Harvest
